paragraph:
The price of staying connected
An island republic discovers that a ferry is more than a business

In the fictional island republic of Pelara, the last ferry approaches a (quay) where passengers shelter beneath a (breezeway). A deckhand lowers the (gangway); another checks a (pulley) that has been making an expensive noise. The vessel is (sturdy), if decidedly (dowdy). The company that owns it is less robust.

Its impending (insolvency) has produced a familiar (paradox). Almost everyone considers the service essential, yet few want to pay what it costs. Ministers promise that a new operator will rise like a (phoenix). Creditors would prefer a balance sheet to a bird.

In its (heyday), the company carried pottery made from local (clay), fish and tourists. Now cargo demand is in (flux), while a seasonal (influx) of visitors overwhelms the summer timetable. Winter sailings remain half-empty. The (crux) is not whether the islands need transport, but how to distribute the cost of maintaining it.

The (orthodox) proposal is to tender the routes to a private operator. A (heterodox) rival would put the fleet in a passenger cooperative. Either could work badly. The (fallacy) is to assume that ownership alone determines the (efficacy) of a service whose obligations have never been clearly priced.

The government proposes a (subsidy) to (defray) the cost of winter crossings. That is defensible if the contract specifies what citizens receive. An (array) of vague promises is less useful than a timetable. The (accuracy) of passenger forecasts matters more than the optimism of the launch ceremony.

Politicians nonetheless compete to (portray) rescue as personal triumph. One minister announces his leadership (candidacy) beside the engine room. His (advocacy) of reform becomes less convincing when he refuses to publish the proposed contract. To (downplay) its costs and (underplay) its risks is to invite disappointment, not confidence.

The opposition leader, a (dandy) in an immaculate coat, claims he can (outfox) the bidders. His aide is an accomplished (toady); the minister's aide accuses him of being a corporate (lackey). Such exchanges are a (parody) of scrutiny. Neither insult tells an islander whether Monday's boat will run.

Pelara's institutions explain some of the difficulty. Its island (confederacy) has an (unwieldy) transport (bureaucracy), and mayors (jockey) for priority. A dockside commentator calls the system a (gerontocracy), a business lobby calls it an (autocracy), and a columnist in a (racy) weekly detects a (plutocracy). The labels are plentiful; the spare parts are not.

Other caricatures are less convincing still. The shipping families are described as an (aristocracy), and a church campaign for Sunday sailings is denounced as a (theocracy). When women win most seats on the transport board, an opponent warns of (gynaecocracy). A female chair, however, is no more likely than a male one to repair an engine by proclamation.

The board must establish its (supremacy) over contractors without pretending that authority supplies expertise. Its recent (ascendancy) follows years of administrative (dormancy). The danger is replacing (complacency) with frantic intervention. A ferry service needs a competent client, not a daily procession of instructions.

An engineer hired to (assay) a corroded metal fitting offers a useful lesson. A laboratory result can reveal a material (deficiency); it cannot decide which island deserves the first sailing. The (interplay) of technical evidence and public preference is unavoidable. No honest expert can (gainsay) that distinction.

Residents know this better than visiting consultants. On a (windy) morning, a (hardy) nurse waits beside a fisherman whose (reedy) voice barely carries across the harbour. A (tardy) boat may mean a missed appointment or lost earnings. For a (needy) household, an extra hotel night is not a minor inconvenience.

School transport raises a similar issue. Repeated cancellations appear in attendance records as (truancy), concealing the cause. Officials then discuss juvenile (delinquency) as if children controlled the weather. A policy should be (ready) to distinguish a transport failure from a failure of character.

At the terminal, a homeless traveller is questioned under an old (vagrancy) rule. Elsewhere, a frightened (stowaway) is taken into (custody). The cases require attention to circumstances, not a competition in severity. Administrative (leniency) and formal (clemency) are different matters, but both are easily confused with weakness by people far from the dock.

The chairman's attempt to impose discipline has its own hazards. He calls a union's refusal to accept new terms (contumacy); the union calls his position (obstinacy). Neither description resolves the dispute. A (parley) over staffing would be more useful than a test of who can remain angry longest.

Safety, meanwhile, depends on accepting some apparent (redundancy). A second trained engineer may seem idle until the first falls ill. An (understudy) is not wasted merely because the leading performer remains on stage. The same reasoning applies to spare equipment, though every reserve still needs a costed justification.

An (emergency) makes that principle visible. When the main vessel fails, a charter carries clinic supplies, including a box of (antibody) testing kits. A passenger describes the rescue as a miracle. The mechanic calls it maintenance that should have happened earlier. Avoiding a (tragedy) is better than composing a moving speech afterwards.

The service also sustains less measurable pleasures. In the (galley), a cook prepares a local (delicacy). On deck, an amateur band plays a (medley), interrupted by a (bawdy) joke and an (off-key) chorus. A travel writer produces a (rhapsody) about island life. Its (vibrancy), however, depends partly on a prosaic supply chain.

Even the scenery contains a warning. A (muddy) stream feeds an (eddy) beside the pier, where floating rubbish gathers. The harbourmaster explains the (intricacy) of dredging schedules and tides. Tourism advertisements prefer a (moody) sunset. Pictures sell passages; working infrastructure makes them possible.

Rumours complicate negotiations. Critics allege a (conspiracy) to transfer public assets cheaply. A leaked figure shows a (discrepancy) between two valuations, but (hearsay) is not proof of (perfidy). The difference deserves explanation. So does the bidder's assumption that fuel costs will remain conveniently stable.

The minister should neither dismiss every sceptic as someone determined to (naysay) nor surrender to every person who tries to (waylay) him outside parliament. He needs enough (leeway) to negotiate, coupled with limits that prevent him from allowing talks to (stray) beyond his mandate. Accountability requires boundaries and disclosure, not government by ambush.

A credible settlement would (embody) (decency) towards passengers and (consistency) towards operators. It would acknowledge uncertainty rather than dress a forecast as a (prophecy). Political (inconstancy) can be as costly as mechanical failure: investors charge for promises they do not trust.

The final agreement should therefore (allay) fears through enforceable obligations. Choosing short-term (expediency) could (betray) residents and put the whole rescue in (jeopardy). Pelara does not need a heroic operator. It needs an ordinary one that keeps turning up.
translation:
保持联通的代价
一个岛国共和国发现，渡轮不只是一门生意

在虚构的岛国共和国佩拉拉，末班渡轮驶近一座(码头)，乘客们正在(有顶通风走廊)下躲避风雨。一名水手放下(舷梯)，另一名检查一个不断发出昂贵维修征兆的(滑轮)。船身虽然明显(老土)，倒还(结实)。拥有它的公司就没那么稳健了。

公司即将(资不抵债)，由此产生了一个熟悉的(悖论)：几乎人人都认为这项服务不可或缺，却很少有人愿意承担其成本。部长们承诺，新运营商将像(凤凰)一样重生。债权人更想看资产负债表，而不是鸟。

在(鼎盛时期)，公司运输用本地(黏土)制作的陶器、鱼类和游客。如今，货运需求处于(变动)之中，季节性游客的(涌入)则让夏季班次不堪重负。冬季航班却仍有一半座位空着。(关键)并非岛屿是否需要交通，而是如何分摊维持交通的成本。

(正统的)方案是将航线招标交给私人运营商。一个(非正统的)竞争方案则主张把船队交给乘客合作社。两者都可能运作不佳。真正的(谬误)，是认为所有权本身就能决定一项服务的(效能)，而这项服务应承担的义务甚至从未被明确计价。

政府提出提供(补贴)，以(支付)冬季航行的成本。如果合同明确规定公民能获得什么，这就说得过去。一(系列)含糊承诺，不如一张时刻表有用。客流预测的(准确性)，比启动仪式上的乐观情绪更重要。

然而，政客们仍争相将救援(描绘)为个人胜利。一名部长在机舱旁宣布自己的领导职位(参选资格)。当他拒绝公布拟议合同时，他对改革的(倡导)就显得不那么可信了。(淡化)成本、(低估)风险，招来的将是失望，而非信心。

反对派领袖是个穿着一尘不染外套的(花花公子)，声称自己能够(智胜)竞标者。他的助手是个老练的(马屁精)；部长的助手则指责他是企业的(走狗)。这种交锋是对监督的(拙劣模仿)。两种辱骂都无法告诉岛民，星期一的船是否会开。

佩拉拉的制度解释了部分困难。这个岛屿(邦联)有一套(笨重低效的)交通(官僚机构)，各岛市长都在(争夺)优先权。码头边的一位评论者称其为(老人统治)，商业游说团体称其为(独裁统治)，一家(言辞泼辣的)周刊的专栏作家则看出了(财阀统治)。标签很多，备件却不多。

另一些讽刺描述更难令人信服。航运家族被描绘成(贵族阶层)，教会争取周日航班的活动被斥为(神权统治)。当女性赢得交通委员会多数席位时，一名反对者又警告说这是(女性统治)。然而，女主席与男主席一样，都不可能靠发布宣言修好发动机。

委员会必须确立对承包商的(最高支配权)，但不能假装权力自然带来专业知识。在多年行政(休眠)之后，它最近才取得(主导地位)。危险在于用疯狂干预取代(自满)。渡轮服务需要的是一个有能力的委托方，而不是每天接连不断的指令。

一名受雇(化验分析)腐蚀金属配件的工程师，提供了有益的启示。实验结果能够揭示材料的(缺陷)，却无法决定哪座岛应当获得首班船。技术证据与公众偏好之间的(相互作用)不可避免。任何诚实的专家都无法(否认)这一区别。

居民比来访顾问更明白这一点。在一个(多风的)早晨，一位(吃苦耐劳的)护士站在渔民旁等船，后者(尖细的)声音几乎传不过港口。一班(迟到的)船，可能意味着错过预约或损失收入。对一个(贫困的)家庭而言，多住一晚酒店绝非小小的不便。

学生交通也带来类似问题。反复取消的航班在出勤记录中变成了(逃学)，真正原因却被掩盖。官员随后讨论青少年(不良行为)，仿佛孩子能够控制天气。政策应当(准备好)区分交通故障与品行问题。

在客运站，一名无家可归的旅客依据一项旧有的(流浪)规定受到盘问。另一处，一名惊恐的(偷渡者)被(拘留)。这些案件需要具体考察情形，而不是比赛谁更严厉。行政上的(宽大处理)与正式的(赦免)并非一回事，但远离码头的人很容易把两者都误认为软弱。

主席试图整顿纪律，也有其自身风险。他把工会拒绝接受新条款称为(抗命)，工会则把他的立场称为(顽固)。两种描述都无法解决争端。就人员配置进行一场(谈判)，比测试谁能生气更久更有用。

与此同时，安全有赖于接受某种表面上的(冗余)。第二位受过训练的工程师，可能看起来无所事事，直到第一位生病。不能因为主角仍在台上，就认定(替补演员)是浪费。同样的道理适用于备用设备，尽管每项储备仍需经过成本论证。

一场(紧急情况)让这个原则变得清晰。主力船发生故障后，一艘包船运送了诊所物资，其中包括一箱(抗体)检测试剂盒。一名乘客称这次救援为奇迹。机械师则说，这是早该完成的维护拖出来的结果。避免一场(悲剧)，比事后写一篇感人的演说更好。

这项服务也维系着难以量化的乐趣。在(船上厨房)，厨师准备着一种本地(美味)。甲板上，业余乐队演奏一组(串烧曲)，间或插入一个(粗俗的)笑话和一段(跑调的)合唱。一位旅行作家写下对岛屿生活的(热情赞歌)。然而，这种生活的(活力)，部分取决于一条平凡的供应链。

就连景色也包含警示。一条(浑浊的)溪流汇入栈桥旁的(漩涡)，漂浮垃圾在那里聚集。港务长解释疏浚安排与潮汐之间的(复杂关系)。旅游广告更喜欢一片(忧郁的)夕阳。图片能卖出船票，正常运转的基础设施才能让旅程成真。

传闻让谈判更加复杂。批评者指称，有人策划了一场廉价转移公共资产的(阴谋)。泄露的数据表明，两项估值之间存在(差异)，但(道听途说)不是(背信弃义)的证据。这一差异值得解释。竞标者为何假定燃油成本会恰好保持稳定，同样需要解释。

部长既不应把所有怀疑者都斥为一心(唱反调)的人，也不应向每一个试图在议会外(拦住)他的人让步。他需要足够的(回旋余地)来谈判，同时也需要限制，防止谈判(偏离)授权范围。问责需要边界与披露，而不是靠突袭拦人来治理国家。

一份可信的协议，应当(体现)对乘客的(公道体面)，以及对运营商的(一贯性)。它应承认不确定性，而不是把预测装扮成(预言)。政治上的(反复无常)，可能与机械故障一样昂贵：投资者会为那些自己不信任的承诺索取风险补偿。

因此，最终协议应当以可执行的义务来(缓解)担忧。选择短期(权宜之计)，可能(背叛)居民，并让整个救援陷入(危险)。佩拉拉不需要一位英雄般的运营商。它需要一个普通的、能够持续准时出现的运营商。
text:
本批词根亮点：

• -cracy 大家族：democracy/aristocracy/autocracy/theocracy/plutocracy/bureaucracy/gerontocracy/gynaecocracy，全来自希腊 kratos（统治）

• tragedy：来自希腊语"山羊之歌"（tragos+ode），可能因戏剧奖品是山羊

• toady：来自江湖郎中的助手，假装吞食有毒蟾蜍（toad），后演变为"马屁精"

• conspiracy：con（共同）+ spir（呼吸），共同呼吸秘密=阴谋，inspire/spirit/aspire 同根

• parley/parliament/parole：全来自法语 parler（说话），parlor（客厅）也同根

• redundancy：re（再）+ unda（波），浪潮一再涌来=多余，inundate（淹没）同根

• jeopardy：来自法语"均等的游戏"（jeu parti），表示五五开的危险赌局

quiz.question: phoenix ______
quiz.explanation: 凤凰; 不死鸟, 凤凰涅槃. The company was like a phoenix rising from bankruptcy. 公司就像从破产中凤凰涅槃。 | Phoenix->腓尼基（希腊phoenios->暗红色），phoenix->浴火重生的不死鸟（cf. Phoenicia腓尼基，fennel茴香=凤凰藏身处） || 文化联想：中文常说“凤凰涅槃、浴火重生”，最适合帮助记忆 phoenix，可以说 **a phoenix rising — “A company that recovers spectacularly from near-bankruptcy may look like a phoenix rising from the ashes.”**

quiz.question: _______ paradox
quiz.explanation: 悖论; 矛盾, 逻辑悖论. The statement presents a logical paradox. 这个陈述提出了一个逻辑悖论。 | para->相反，dox->观点（希腊doxa），paradox->与观点相反的=悖论（cf. orthodox正统，heterodox异端，orthodox vs paradox） || 文化联想：中文“看似矛盾却可能同时成立”最适合帮助记忆 paradox，可以说 **a logical paradox — “A statement that appears self-contradictory yet reveals a deeper problem can be a logical paradox.”**

quiz.question: orthodox ______
quiz.explanation: 正统的; 传统的, 正统信仰. He follows orthodox belief in his religion. 他遵循宗教中的正统信仰。 | ortho->正确，dox->观点，orthodox->持正确观点的=正统的（cf. paradox悖论，heterodox异端，orthopedic矫形外科=直骨） || 文化联想：中文“正统观点”最适合帮助记忆 orthodox，可以说 **orthodox belief — “A religious community may distinguish orthodox belief from teachings it considers outside the accepted tradition.”**

quiz.question: heterodox _____
quiz.explanation: 异端的; 非正统的, 异端观点. The philosopher held heterodox views on theology. 哲学家对神学持有异端观点。 | hetero->不同，dox->观点，heterodox->持不同观点的=异端的（cf. orthodox正统，heterogeneous异质，paradox悖论） || 文化联想：中文“离经叛道的观点”最适合帮助记忆 heterodox，可以说 **heterodox views — “A thinker who challenges an established intellectual tradition may hold heterodox views.”**

quiz.question: outfox _ _____
quiz.explanation: 以智取胜; 智胜, 智胜对手. The clever lawyer managed to outfox a rival. 聪明的律师设法智胜对手。 | out->超过，fox->狐狸/狡猾，outfox->比狐狸更狡猾=智胜（cf. foxy狡猾，fox狐狸，sly狡猾，outwit智胜） || 文化联想：《三十六计》里“斗智取胜”的感觉最适合帮助记忆 outfox，可以说 **outfox a rival — “A clever negotiator may outfox a rival by anticipating the other side’s strategy several moves ahead.”**

quiz.question: ________ flux
quiz.explanation: 流动; 变化, 不断的变化. The market is in constant flux. 市场处于不断的变化中。 | flux->流动（拉丁fluere），flux->持续变化的状态（cf. flow流动，fluid流体，influence影响=流入，influenza流感=流行病） || 文化联想：中文“市场风云变幻”最适合帮助记忆 flux，可以说 **in constant flux — “Technology markets are in constant flux as new products, companies, and business models appear.”**

quiz.question: __ influx __ ________
quiz.explanation: 涌入; 流入, 游客涌入. The city experienced an influx of tourists. 这座城市经历了游客涌入。 | in->进入，flux->流动，influx->流进来=涌入（cf. efflux流出，reflux回流，influence影响=流入，flux变化） || 文化联想：春运期间大量旅客涌入车站的场景最适合帮助记忆 influx，可以说 **an influx of travelers — “Before Spring Festival, a major railway station may experience an influx of travelers heading home.”**

quiz.question: ___ crux __ ______
quiz.explanation: 关键; 症结, 问题的关键. Thats the crux of matter we're discussing. 那是我们正在讨论的问题的关键。 | crux->十字架（拉丁，交叉点），crux->关键交叉点（cf. cross十字，crucial关键的，excruciate折磨=钉十字架） || 文化联想：中文“抓住问题症结”最适合帮助记忆 crux，可以说 **the crux of the matter — “After a long debate, one clear question may finally reveal the crux of the matter.”**

quiz.question: __ ___ heyday
quiz.explanation: 全盛时期, 在其全盛时期. The empire was in its heyday during that century. 帝国在那个世纪处于其全盛时期。 | heyday->兴旺时期（来源不明，可能来自hey欢呼），heyday->顶峰时期（cf. hey嗨，prime全盛，zenith顶点） || 文化联想：“盛唐”作为全盛时期的形象最适合帮助记忆 heyday，可以说 **in its heyday — “Chang’an in the Tang dynasty was, in its heyday, one of the world’s great cosmopolitan cities.”**

quiz.question: ________ clay
quiz.explanation: 粘土; 泥土, 造型粘土. Children enjoy playing with modeling clay. 孩子们喜欢玩造型粘土。 | clay->粘土（古英语clæg），clay->可塑的粘土（cf. clayey粘土质的，feet of clay泥足=致命弱点，claymore大刀） || 文化联想：景德镇陶艺师拉坯最适合帮助记忆 clay，可以说 **modeling clay — “A potter in Jingdezhen may shape modeling clay on a wheel before firing the finished vessel.”**

quiz.question: allay _____
quiz.explanation: 减轻; 缓和, 减轻恐惧. The doctor tried to allay fears about the procedure. 医生试图减轻对手术的恐惧。 | al->向下，lay->放置，allay->把恐惧放下=减轻（cf. lay放置，slay杀死，overlay覆盖，allaying缓和） || 文化联想：中文“安抚人心”最适合帮助记忆 allay，可以说 **allay fears — “A doctor may explain a procedure carefully to allay fears before treatment.”**

quiz.question: downplay ____
quiz.explanation: 轻描淡写; 低估, 低估风险. Officials tend to downplay risk to the public. 官员倾向于对公众低估风险。 | down->向下，play->表现，downplay->把表现往低调整=轻描淡写（cf. underplay低估，overplay夸大，play down淡化） || 文化联想：中文“轻描淡写风险”最适合帮助记忆 downplay，可以说 **downplay the risk — “A company should not downplay the risk of a serious safety defect when speaking to customers.”**

quiz.question: underplay ____
quiz.explanation: 低估; 轻描淡写, 低估风险. Do not underplay risk in your analysis. 不要在你的分析中低估风险。 | under->低于，play->表现，underplay->表现低于实际=低估（cf. downplay轻描淡写，overplay夸大，understate轻描淡写） || 文化联想：中文“低估风险”最适合帮助记忆 underplay，可以说 **underplay the risk — “An investor who focuses only on possible gains may underplay the risk of a highly volatile asset.”**

quiz.question: ______ interplay
quiz.explanation: 相互作用; 相互影响, 微妙的相互作用. There is a subtle interplay between the characters. 角色之间有微妙的相互作用。 | inter->之间，play->相互作用，interplay->之间的相互作用（cf. interact互动，interweave交织，interplay相互影响） || 文化联想：中国围棋里攻守不断相互影响的感觉最适合帮助记忆 interplay，可以说 **a subtle interplay — “A close Go match can involve a subtle interplay between attack, defense, territory, and initiative.”**

quiz.question: waylay _ ________
quiz.explanation: 伏击; 拦路抢劫, 伏击旅行者. Bandits would waylay a traveler on the road. 强盗会在路上伏击旅行者。 | way->路，lay->设置，waylay->在路上设置埋伏=伏击（cf. ambush埋伏，lay a trap设陷阱，waylaying拦截） || 文化联想：古代山路上强盗设伏的画面最适合帮助记忆 waylay，可以说 **waylay a traveler — “In an old adventure story, bandits may hide beside a mountain road and waylay a traveler.”**

quiz.question: defray _____
quiz.explanation: 支付; 负担费用, 支付费用. Sponsors will defray costs of the event. 赞助商将支付活动费用。 | de->向外，fray->费用（古法语frayer->支付），defray->付出费用（cf. fray磨损/争斗，affray骚乱=一种争斗） || 文化联想：中文“由赞助方承担费用”最适合帮助记忆 defray，可以说 **defray the costs — “A local sponsor may defray the costs of a community festival by paying for the venue and equipment.”**

quiz.question: __ array __
quiz.explanation: 一系列; 排列, 一系列. The buffet offers an array of dishes. 自助餐提供一系列菜肴。 | ar->朝向，ray->排列（古法语aroi->排列），array->排成一列=一系列（cf. display展示，disarray混乱，ray射线） || 文化联想：年夜饭一大桌菜最适合帮助记忆 array，可以说 **an array of dishes — “A Spring Festival reunion dinner may present an impressive array of dishes across the table.”**

quiz.question: betray _ ______
quiz.explanation: 背叛; 泄露, 泄露秘密. Do not betray a secret that was told in confidence. 不要泄露私下告诉你的秘密。 | be->彻底，tray->传递（拉丁tradere），betray->彻底传递出去=背叛（cf. tradition传统，traitor叛徒，trade交易） || 文化联想：中文“把别人托付的秘密泄露出去”最适合帮助记忆 betray，可以说 **betray a secret — “Telling outsiders something shared in confidence may betray a secret and damage trust.”**

quiz.question: portray _ ____
quiz.explanation: 描绘; 扮演, 扮演英雄. The actor will portray a hero in the film. 演员将在电影中扮演英雄。 | por->向前，tray->拉（拉丁trahere），portray->向前拉出描绘=描绘（cf. portrait肖像，betray背叛，trait特征） || 文化联想：中国影视剧里演员扮演英雄人物最适合帮助记忆 portray，可以说 **portray a hero — “An actor in a historical film may portray a hero whose courage becomes central to the story.”**

quiz.question: stray ___
quiz.explanation: 走失的; 流浪的, 流浪狗. They rescued a stray dog from the street. 他们从街上救了一只流浪狗。 | stray->离开正路（古法语estraier->徘徊），stray->偏离=流浪（cf. astray误入歧途，straggle零散，stray from偏离） || 文化联想：中国街头救助流浪狗最适合帮助记忆 stray，可以说 **a stray dog — “Volunteers may rescue a stray dog from the street and take it to an animal shelter.”**

quiz.question: ______ gainsay
quiz.explanation: 否认; 反驳, 断然否认. He will flatly gainsay all accusations. 他将断然否认所有指控。 | gain->反对（古英语gean->对抗），say->说，gainsay->说反对话=否认（cf. deny否认，contradict反驳，naysay反对） || 文化联想：中文“当面驳斥”最适合帮助记忆 gainsay，可以说 **gainsay a claim — “A researcher may gainsay a claim by presenting clear evidence that contradicts it.”**

quiz.question: ____ hearsay
quiz.explanation: 传闻; 道听途说, 仅仅是传闻. The evidence is mere hearsay and inadmissible. 证据仅仅是传闻,不可采纳。 | hear->听，say->说，hearsay->听说的话=传闻（cf. rumor谣言，gossip八卦，hearsay evidence传闻证据） || 文化联想：中文“道听途说”最适合帮助记忆 hearsay，可以说 **mere hearsay — “A rumor repeated from person to person may remain mere hearsay without direct evidence.”**

quiz.question: ___ __ assay
quiz.explanation: 化验; 分析, 进行化验. The lab will run an assay on the sample. 实验室将对样本进行化验。 | as->朝向，say->试（古法语essayer->尝试），assay->朝目标试验=化验（cf. essay文章=尝试，essayist散文家，assay化验） || 文化联想：中国实验室化验样本最适合帮助记忆 assay，可以说 **run an assay — “A laboratory may run an assay on a blood or chemical sample to measure a specific substance.”**

quiz.question: naysay ________
quiz.explanation: 反对; 否定, 反对提案. Critics will naysay proposal without consideration. 批评者会不加考虑地反对提案。 | nay->不（古英语nei），say->说，naysay->说不=反对（cf. yea是，nay否，naysayer反对者，gainsay否认） || 文化联想：中文“逢提案就唱反调”最适合帮助记忆 naysay，可以说 **naysay a proposal — “A critic who rejects every idea before examining it may simply naysay a proposal.”**

quiz.question: _____ quay
quiz.explanation: 码头, 石码头. Ships dock at the stone quay. 船只停靠在石码头。 | quay->码头（法语quai，凯尔特语cae->围墙），quay->石砌的停船处（注意ay发ee音，cf. quayside码头边，pier码头） || 文化联想：上海等沿江城市的石砌码头最适合帮助记忆 quay，可以说 **a stone quay — “Fishing boats may tie up beside a stone quay along an old riverside harbor.”**

quiz.question: ____ stowaway
quiz.explanation: 偷渡者, 船上偷渡者. Security found a ship stowaway hidden below deck. 安全人员发现一名藏在甲板下的船上偷渡者。 | stow->收藏，away->离开，stowaway->藏起来离开的人=偷渡者（cf. stow收放，runaway逃跑者，castaway遭遇船难者） || 文化联想：电影里有人藏在船舱里偷渡最适合帮助记忆 stowaway，可以说 **a ship stowaway — “Crew members may discover a ship stowaway hiding below deck during a long voyage.”**

quiz.question: ____ leeway
quiz.explanation: 余地; 自由, 给予余地. The manager will give leeway for creativity. 经理会给予创造性的余地。 | lee->背风（古英语hleo->庇护），way->空间，leeway->背风侧的空间=余地/自由（cf. leeward背风的，room空间，latitude纬度/自由） || 文化联想：中文“给别人留点余地”最适合帮助记忆 leeway，可以说 **give leeway — “A good manager may give leeway to experienced employees so they can solve problems creatively.”**

quiz.question: _______ breezeway
quiz.explanation: 有顶过道, 有顶过道. A covered breezeway connects the buildings. 有顶过道连接这些建筑。 | breeze->微风，way->通道，breezeway->让微风通过的通道=有顶走廊（cf. breeze微风，walkway走道，corridor走廊） || 文化联想：岭南建筑里通风的有顶连廊很适合帮助记忆 breezeway，可以说 **a covered breezeway — “Two buildings in a warm climate may be linked by a covered breezeway that lets air move freely.”**

quiz.question: ________ gangway
quiz.explanation: 舷梯; 通道, 飞机舷梯. Passengers board via the aircraft gangway. 乘客通过飞机舷梯登机。 | gang->行走（古英语gangan->走），way->通道，gangway->供人行走的通道=舷梯（cf. gangplank跳板，gangster帮派=一起走的人） || 文化联想：乘客通过舷梯或登机通道上船上机最适合帮助记忆 gangway，可以说 **an aircraft gangway — “Passengers may walk through an aircraft gangway from the terminal directly to the plane.”**

quiz.question: ____ efficacy
quiz.explanation: 功效; 效力, 药物功效. Clinical trials test drug efficacy. 临床试验测试药物功效。 | effic->做到（拉丁efficere），efficacy->实际做到的能力=功效（cf. efficient有效，effect效果，efficacious有效的） || 文化联想：中国医院临床试验检验药物效果最适合帮助记忆 efficacy，可以说 **drug efficacy — “A clinical trial is designed in part to measure the efficacy of a new drug.”**

quiz.question: delicacy ____
quiz.explanation: 美味; 精致, 美味拼盘. The delicacy tray featured exotic foods. 美味拼盘以异国食物为特色。 | delicate->精致（拉丁delicatus->令人愉悦的），delicacy->精致的食物=美食（cf. delicious美味，delight快乐，delicate精致） || 文化联想：中国各地“地方名吃”最适合帮助记忆 delicacy，可以说 **a local delicacy — “Visitors to Suzhou may try a local delicacy that is especially associated with the region.”**

quiz.question: ______ intricacy
quiz.explanation: 复杂性; 错综复杂, 设计的复杂性. The design intricacy required skilled craftsmen. 设计的复杂性需要熟练的工匠。 | intricate->错综复杂（拉丁intricare->使纠缠），intricacy->纠缠复杂的性质（cf. intricate复杂，trick技巧，intrigue密谋） || 文化联想：苏绣针法和纹样的复杂精细最适合帮助记忆 intricacy，可以说 **the intricacy of the design — “The intricacy of a Suzhou embroidery design may require thousands of tiny, carefully placed stitches.”**

quiz.question: ___-_______ advocacy
quiz.explanation: 拥护; 提倡, 枪支管制倡导. Gun-control advocacy groups lobbied legislators. 枪支管制倡导团体游说立法者。 | advoc->呼唤（拉丁advocare->召唤），advocacy->大声呼唤支持=倡导（cf. advocate倡导者，vocal声音的，invoke祈求） || 文化联想：中国公益组织推动环保议题最适合帮助记忆 advocacy，可以说 **environmental advocacy — “A nonprofit group may use environmental advocacy to promote cleaner rivers and stronger conservation rules.”**

quiz.question: ____________ candidacy
quiz.explanation: 候选资格, 总统候选资格. She announced her presidential candidacy yesterday. 她昨天宣布了她的总统候选资格。 | candid->白色/坦诚（拉丁candidus->穿白袍的），candidacy->参选资格（cf. candidate候选人=穿白袍者，candid坦率的，candor坦诚） || 文化联想：中文“正式宣布参选”最适合帮助记忆 candidacy，可以说 **announce a candidacy — “A politician may announce a candidacy after building a campaign team and gathering support.”**

quiz.question: _______ fallacy
quiz.explanation: 谬误; 谬论, 逻辑谬误. The argument contains a logical fallacy. 这个论点包含逻辑谬误。 | fall->欺骗（拉丁fallere），fallacy->欺骗性的谬误（cf. false假的，fallacious谬误的，infallible不会错的，fail失败） || 文化联想：中文“以偏概全”是常见逻辑谬误，最适合帮助记忆 fallacy，可以说 **a logical fallacy — “Judging an entire group from one isolated example is a logical fallacy.”**

quiz.question: ______ supremacy
quiz.explanation: 至高无上; 霸权, 全球霸权. Nations compete for global supremacy. 国家竞争全球霸权。 | suprem->最高（拉丁supremus），supremacy->最高地位（cf. supreme最高，superlative最高级，suprème高级） || 文化联想：中文“争夺最高主导地位”最适合帮助记忆 supremacy，可以说 **seek supremacy — “Two major powers may compete for technological supremacy in strategically important industries.”**

quiz.question: _________ contumacy
quiz.explanation: 抗命; 不服从, 政治抗命. The dissident showed political contumacy. 异见者表现出政治抗命。 | contum->傲慢（拉丁contumax），contumacy->顽固违抗=抗命（cf. contumacious违抗的，tumult骚乱，insolence傲慢） || 文化联想：中文“抗命不从”最适合帮助记忆 contumacy，可以说 **open contumacy — “Repeatedly refusing a lawful court order may amount to open contumacy.”**

quiz.question: _____ obstinacy
quiz.explanation: 固执; 顽固, 纯粹的固执. His sheer obstinacy prevented compromise. 他纯粹的固执阻止了妥协。 | ob->对抗，stin->站立，obstinacy->始终对抗站立=顽固（cf. obstinate固执，abstain禁止=站远，desist停止=离开站立位） || 文化联想：中文“死犟、一根筋”最适合帮助记忆 obstinacy，可以说 **sheer obstinacy — “Sheer obstinacy can prevent two sides from reaching a compromise even when their differences are small.”**

quiz.question: racy _____
quiz.explanation: 活泼的; 猥亵的, 猥亵的幽默. The comedians racy humor offended some. 喜剧演员猥亵的幽默冒犯了一些人。 | racy->有劲道的（race->刺激），racy->刺激/猥亵的（cf. racy style活泼文风，race竞赛，racy joke猥亵笑话） || 文化联想：中文“荤段子、略带露骨的幽默”最适合帮助记忆 racy，可以说 **racy humor — “A comedian may use racy humor that makes some adults laugh but is not suitable for children.”**

quiz.question: gynaecocracy ____
quiz.explanation: 女性统治, 女性统治. Gynaecocracy rule was rare in ancient times. 女性统治在古代很罕见。 | gynaeco->女性（希腊gyne），cracy->统治，gynaecocracy->女性统治（cf. gynecology妇科，democracy民主，bureaucracy官僚） || 文化联想：gynaecocracy 是“女性掌权”的政治概念，可用中国学生讨论武则天时作为理解入口，但二者并不完全等价，可以说 **a gynaecocracy — “A political-history student may use the term gynaecocracy for a system in which women hold governing power.”**

quiz.question: _________ theocracy
quiz.explanation: 神权政治, 宗教神权政治. The religious theocracy controlled all aspects of life. 宗教神权政治控制了生活的方方面面。 | theo->神（希腊theos），cracy->统治，theocracy->神统治=神权政治（cf. theology神学，atheist无神论者，enthusiasm神灵附体） || 文化联想：theocracy 是“神权政治”，可用中国学生学习世界宗教政治制度时来记忆，可以说 **a religious theocracy — “In a political-science class, students may study a religious theocracy in which religious authority directly shapes government.”**

quiz.question: gerontocracy ____
quiz.explanation: 老人统治, 老人统治. Gerontocracy rule dominated the society. 老人统治主导了社会。 | geronto->老人（希腊geron），cracy->统治，gerontocracy->老人统治（cf. gerontology老年学，geriatric老年的） || 文化联想：中文“老人掌权”最适合帮助记忆 gerontocracy，可以说 **a gerontocracy — “A political system dominated for decades by a small group of very old leaders may be described as a gerontocracy.”**

quiz.question: ______ aristocracy
quiz.explanation: 贵族政治; 贵族阶层, 法国贵族. The French aristocracy was overthrown in revolution. 法国贵族在革命中被推翻。 | aristo->最好（希腊aristos），cracy->统治，aristocracy->最好的人统治=贵族（cf. aristocrat贵族，democrat民主者，autocrat独裁者） || 文化联想：中国历史里的“门阀士族”可以作为 aristocracy 的类比入口，但并非完全等价，可以说 **a hereditary aristocracy — “A hereditary aristocracy concentrates status and privilege in families whose position passes from one generation to the next.”**

quiz.question: ________ autocracy
quiz.explanation: 专制; 独裁, 绝对专制. The absolute autocracy suppressed all dissent. 绝对专制压制了所有异议。 | auto->自己，cracy->统治，autocracy->自己统治=专制（cf. autocrat独裁者，automobile汽车，automatic自动的） || 文化联想：中文“一人独断专行”最适合帮助记忆 autocracy，可以说 **absolute autocracy — “When one ruler faces almost no effective institutional limits, the system may become an absolute autocracy.”**

quiz.question: _________ plutocracy
quiz.explanation: 富豪统治, 企业富豪统治. Critics fear a corporate plutocracy rules the nation. 批评者担心企业富豪统治统治着国家。 | pluto->财富（希腊ploutos），cracy->统治，plutocracy->有钱人统治（cf. Pluto冥王星=冥界，plutonium钚） || 文化联想：中文“金钱政治、富豪掌权”最适合帮助记忆 plutocracy，可以说 **a plutocracy — “A society in which a tiny wealthy elite has disproportionate political power may be criticized as a plutocracy.”**

quiz.question: _______ bureaucracy
quiz.explanation: 官僚主义; 官僚机构, 臃肿的官僚机构. The bloated bureaucracy slows decision-making. 臃肿的官僚机构减慢了决策。 | bureau->办公桌（法语），cracy->统治，bureaucracy->办公桌统治=官僚（cf. bureau办事处，bureaucrat官僚，technocracy技术官僚） || 文化联想：中文“层层审批、办个事盖很多章”最适合帮助记忆 bureaucracy，可以说 **a bloated bureaucracy — “A bloated bureaucracy can slow a simple project through repeated forms, approvals, and overlapping offices.”**

quiz.question: ________ confederacy
quiz.explanation: 邦联; 同盟, 南方邦联. The southern confederacy fought in the Civil War. 南方邦联在内战中作战。 | con->共同，feder->联盟（拉丁foedus），confederacy->共同联盟（cf. federal联邦，federation联合会，ally盟友） || 文化联想：confederacy 是“邦联/松散联盟”，可用中国学生学习美国内战史时来记忆，可以说 **a southern confederacy — “In a U.S. history class, students may study the southern Confederacy that fought during the Civil War.”**

quiz.question: ________ conspiracy
quiz.explanation: 阴谋; 共谋, 犯罪阴谋. The court uncovered a criminal conspiracy. 法院揭露了一起犯罪阴谋。 | con->共同，spir->呼吸（拉丁spirare），conspiracy->共同呼吸秘密=阴谋（cf. inspire鼓励，spirit精神，aspire渴望，expire呼气/到期） || 文化联想：中文“几个人暗中串联密谋”最适合帮助记忆 conspiracy，可以说 **a criminal conspiracy — “Several people who secretly plan an illegal scheme together may form a criminal conspiracy.”**

quiz.question: ________ accuracy
quiz.explanation: 准确性; 精确, 精确的准确性. The GPS provides pinpoint accuracy. GPS提供精确的准确性。 | accur->关心（拉丁accurare->精心处理），accuracy->精心处理后的精确（cf. accurate精确，cure治愈，curator馆长，accurate=cured of errors） || 文化联想：北斗定位强调高精度最适合帮助记忆 accuracy，可以说 **pinpoint accuracy — “A modern navigation system can provide near-pinpoint accuracy under favorable conditions.”**

quiz.question: _______ prophecy
quiz.explanation: 预言, 实现预言. Events seemed to fulfill prophecy exactly. 事件似乎完全实现了预言。 | pro->提前，phecy->说（希腊phemi），prophecy->提前说出的=预言（cf. prophet先知，blasphemy亵渎，euphemism委婉说法） || 文化联想：中文“预言成真”最适合帮助记忆 prophecy，可以说 **fulfill a prophecy — “In a legend, later events may appear to fulfill a prophecy made many years earlier.”**

quiz.question: _________ ascendancy
quiz.explanation: 优势; 支配地位, 政治优势. The party gained political ascendancy. 该党获得了政治优势。 | ascend->上升，ancy->状态，ascendancy->持续上升的状态=优势（cf. ascend上升，descend下降，transcend超越） || 文化联想：中文“逐渐取得上风”最适合帮助记忆 ascendancy，可以说 **gain ascendancy — “A new technology may gain ascendancy when it becomes cheaper, faster, and more widely adopted than older alternatives.”**

quiz.question: _____ redundancy
quiz.explanation: 裁员; 冗余, 员工裁员. The company announced staff redundancy. 公司宣布了员工裁员。 | re->再，und->波（拉丁unda），redundancy->波浪一再涌来=多余/裁员（cf. abundant丰富，inundate淹没，undulate波动） || 文化联想：中国企业裁员时的人力冗余最适合帮助记忆 redundancy，可以说 **staff redundancy — “A merger may create staff redundancy when two departments perform almost the same work.”**

quiz.question: ______ dormancy
quiz.explanation: 休眠; 静止, 冬季休眠. Plants enter winter dormancy to survive cold. 植物进入冬季休眠以度过寒冷。 | dorm->睡眠（拉丁dormire），dormancy->沉睡的状态（cf. dormitory宿舍，dormant休眠的，dormouse睡鼠） || 文化联想：中国北方植物冬天进入休眠最适合帮助记忆 dormancy，可以说 **winter dormancy — “Many garden plants enter winter dormancy and resume active growth when spring returns.”**

quiz.question: ____ discrepancy
quiz.explanation: 差异; 不符, 数据差异. Researchers found a data discrepancy in results. 研究人员在结果中发现了数据差异。 | dis->分开，crep->噼啪声（拉丁crepare），discrepancy->发出不同的声音=差异（cf. decrepit破旧，discredit使丢脸，crepuscular黄昏的） || 文化联想：中文“对账对不上”最适合帮助记忆 discrepancy，可以说 **a data discrepancy — “An accountant may investigate a data discrepancy when two reports show different totals for the same period.”**

quiz.question: _____ vibrancy
quiz.explanation: 活力; 生气, 城市活力. The neighborhood is known for its urban vibrancy. 该社区以其城市活力而闻名。 | vibr->振动（拉丁vibrare），vibrancy->充满振动活力的状态（cf. vibrate振动，vibrant充满活力的，vibration震动） || 文化联想：成都夜市和街区的热闹活力最适合帮助记忆 vibrancy，可以说 **urban vibrancy — “Busy food streets, teahouses, music, and late-night crowds can give Chengdu a distinctive urban vibrancy.”**

quiz.question: vagrancy ___
quiz.explanation: 流浪; 游荡, 流浪法. The vagrancy law was challenged in court. 流浪法在法庭上受到质疑。 | vagr->漫游（拉丁vagari），vagrancy->到处漫游的行为=流浪（cf. vagrant流浪者，vague模糊，vagabond流浪者，extravagant奢侈） || 文化联想：中文“流浪游荡”最适合帮助记忆 vagrancy，可以说 **a vagrancy law — “A legal-history class may examine how a vagrancy law regulated or punished people living without a fixed home.”**

quiz.question: _________ inconstancy
quiz.explanation: 不稳定; 易变, 情绪不稳定. His emotional inconstancy made relationships difficult. 他的情绪不稳定使关系变得困难。 | in->否定，constant->恒定的，inconstancy->不恒定的状态=易变（cf. constant恒定，circumstance情况，stance立场） || 文化联想：中文“喜怒无常”最适合帮助记忆 inconstancy，可以说 **emotional inconstancy — “A person whose mood and affection change dramatically from day to day may show emotional inconstancy.”**

quiz.question: truancy _______
quiz.explanation: 逃学, 逃学问题. Schools struggle with the truancy problem. 学校在逃学问题上挣扎。 | truant->流浪者（威尔士语truan->可怜人），truancy->逃学游荡的行为（cf. truant逃学者，vagrant流浪者，delinquent违法者） || 文化联想：中文“逃学去网吧”这个熟悉画面最适合帮助记忆 truancy，可以说 **a truancy problem — “A school may face a truancy problem when students repeatedly skip classes without permission.”**

quiz.question: _________ complacency
quiz.explanation: 自满; 满足, 危险的自满. Success can breed dangerous complacency. 成功会滋生危险的自满。 | com->共同，plac->取悦（拉丁placere），complacency->自我取悦=自满（cf. placate平息，complaisant殷勤，please取悦，placid平静） || 文化联想：中文“骄兵必败”最适合帮助记忆 complacency，可以说 **dangerous complacency — “A successful team that stops preparing seriously may fall into dangerous complacency—正所谓‘骄兵必败.’”**

quiz.question: ______ decency
quiz.explanation: 正派; 体面, 普通礼节. Common decency requires basic courtesy. 普通礼节需要基本礼貌。 | decent->适当（拉丁decere->适合），decency->适当得体的行为（cf. decent体面，decorum礼节，undecided未决定） || 文化联想：中文“做人要有基本体面和礼貌”最适合帮助记忆 decency，可以说 **common decency — “Common decency means treating service workers, neighbors, and strangers with basic respect.”**

quiz.question: emergency ____
quiz.explanation: 紧急情况, 紧急出口. The emergency exit must remain clear. 紧急出口必须保持畅通。 | e->向外，merg->沉（拉丁mergere），emergency->从水中突然冒出=紧急情况（cf. emerge涌现，merge合并，submerge淹没，immerse浸入） || 文化联想：中国商场里绿色的紧急出口标志最适合帮助记忆 emergency，可以说 **an emergency exit — “An emergency exit in a shopping mall must remain unlocked and unobstructed.”**

quiz.question: ____ deficiency
quiz.explanation: 缺乏; 不足, 铁缺乏症. Iron deficiency causes anemia. 铁缺乏症导致贫血。 | de->向下，fic->做（拉丁facere），deficiency->做得不够=不足（cf. deficient不足，proficient熟练，sufficient足够，efficient有效） || 文化联想：中国医院检查缺铁性贫血最适合帮助记忆 deficiency，可以说 **iron deficiency — “A blood test may reveal iron deficiency when the body does not have enough iron for normal red-blood-cell production.”**

quiz.question: _________ expediency
quiz.explanation: 权宜之计, 政治权宜之计. The decision was based on political expediency. 该决定基于政治权宜之计。 | ex->向外，ped->脚，expediency->解放脚去做=权宜（cf. expedient权宜的，expedite加快，impede阻碍=绑住脚） || 文化联想：中文“权宜之计”最适合帮助记忆 expediency，可以说 **political expediency — “A leader may choose a short-term compromise for political expediency even though it is not the best long-term solution.”**

quiz.question: ________ leniency
quiz.explanation: 宽大; 仁慈, 司法宽大. The defendant requested judicial leniency. 被告请求司法宽大。 | leni->柔和（拉丁lenis->温和），leniency->温和对待的行为（cf. lenient宽大，relent软化，relentless不停息） || 文化联想：中文“从轻处理”最适合帮助记忆 leniency，可以说 **judicial leniency — “A first-time offender may ask the court for judicial leniency based on remorse and mitigating circumstances.”**

quiz.question: _____ clemency
quiz.explanation: 宽恕; 仁慈, 给予宽恕. The governor will grant clemency to the prisoner. 州长将给予囚犯宽恕。 | clemens->温和（拉丁），clemency->温和宽容的给予=宽恕（cf. clement温和，inclement恶劣，Clement人名=温和者） || 文化联想：中文“赦免、宽恕”最适合帮助记忆 clemency，可以说 **grant clemency — “A head of government or state may have legal authority in some systems to grant clemency to a prisoner.”**

quiz.question: _______ consistency
quiz.explanation: 一致性; 连贯性, 逻辑一致性. The theory lacks logical consistency. 该理论缺乏逻辑一致性。 | con->共同，sist->站立，consistency->始终站在同一处=一致性（cf. consistent一致，insist坚持，resist抵制，assist协助） || 文化联想：中文“前后一致、自圆其说”最适合帮助记忆 consistency，可以说 **logical consistency — “A theory needs logical consistency so that one part does not contradict another.”**

quiz.question: ________ delinquency
quiz.explanation: 违法; 拖欠, 青少年违法. The program aims to reduce juvenile delinquency. 该项目旨在减少青少年违法。 | de->向下，linqu->放弃，delinquency->放弃责任（cf. delinquent违法者，relinquish放弃，relic遗迹） || 文化联想：中国学校和社区预防青少年违法最适合帮助记忆 delinquency，可以说 **juvenile delinquency — “After-school programs may help reduce juvenile delinquency by giving teenagers structure, support, and supervision.”**

quiz.question: _________ insolvency
quiz.explanation: 无力偿还; 破产, 企业破产. Corporate insolvency rose during the recession. 企业破产在经济衰退期间上升。 | in->否定，solv->解开（拉丁solvere），insolvency->无法解开债务=破产（cf. solve解决，dissolve溶解，resolve决心，solvent溶剂） || 文化联想：中文“资不抵债、无力偿还”最适合帮助记忆 insolvency，可以说 **corporate insolvency — “A company may enter corporate insolvency when it can no longer pay debts as they come due.”**

quiz.question: ready ____
quiz.explanation: 准备好的; 现成的, 现金. The business needs ready cash for operations. 企业需要现金进行运营。 | ready->准备好（古英语ræde->骑马的=随时能出发），ready->准备就绪（cf. ready-made现成的，already已经，readiness准备） || 文化联想：中文“手头现钱”最适合帮助记忆 ready，可以说 **ready cash — “A small business may keep some ready cash available for urgent operating expenses.”**

quiz.question: toady __ _____
quiz.explanation: 谄媚; 拍马屁, 向权力谄媚. He would toady to power to advance his career. 他会向权力谄媚以推进他的职业生涯。 | toady->吞蟾蜍的人（江湖郎中的助手假装吃毒蟾蜍），toady->无原则奉承者=马屁精（cf. toad蟾蜍，sycophant马屁精） || 文化联想：中文“拍马屁、巴结权势”最适合帮助记忆 toady，可以说 **toady to power — “An ambitious employee may toady to power by flattering every senior executive in the room.”**

quiz.question: _____ eddy
quiz.explanation: 漩涡, 水漩涡. The water eddy swirled near the rocks. 水漩涡在岩石附近旋转。 | eddy->漩涡（古挪威iða->漩涡），eddy->水流回旋（cf. whirlpool漩涡，swirl旋转，current水流） || 文化联想：江河岩石旁打转的小漩涡最适合帮助记忆 eddy，可以说 **a water eddy — “A small water eddy may form behind a rock where the current curls back on itself.”**

quiz.question: muddy _____
quiz.explanation: 泥泞的; 混浊的, 混浊的水. The river ran with muddy water after the rain. 雨后河水变得混浊。 | mud->泥（古英语mudde），muddy->充满泥的=混浊的（cf. muddle混乱，mudslide泥石流，muddy the waters混淆视听） || 文化联想：黄河雨后浑浊的河水最适合帮助记忆 muddy，可以说 **muddy water — “After heavy rain upstream, a river may carry muddy water filled with suspended soil.”**

quiz.question: needy ______
quiz.explanation: 贫困的; 需要帮助的, 贫困家庭. The charity helps needy family in the community. 慈善机构帮助社区中的贫困家庭。 | need->需要（古英语nied），needy->充满需要的=贫困的（cf. need需要，neediness贫困，heed注意，indeed确实） || 文化联想：中国慈善机构帮助困难家庭最适合帮助记忆 needy，可以说 **a needy family — “A local charity may provide food, school supplies, and temporary assistance to a needy family.”**

quiz.question: reedy _____
quiz.explanation: 芦苇般的; 尖细的, 尖细的声音. The old man spoke in a reedy voice. 老人用尖细的声音说话。 | reed->芦苇（古英语hreod），reedy->像芦苇一样细的（cf. reed芦苇，reed instrument簧管乐器，reedy sound细长声） || 文化联想：中文“像芦苇一样细尖的嗓音”最适合帮助记忆 reedy，可以说 **a reedy voice — “An elderly storyteller may speak in a thin, reedy voice that still carries clearly across a quiet room.”**

quiz.question: _____ tragedy
quiz.explanation: 悲剧, 希腊悲剧. Greek tragedy explored human fate and suffering. 希腊悲剧探讨人类命运和苦难。 | tragos->山羊（希腊），ody->歌曲，tragedy->山羊歌=悲剧（戏剧奖品是山羊，或演员穿山羊皮，cf. tragic悲剧的，comedy喜剧） || 文化联想：tragedy 是西方戏剧传统的重要概念，可用中国学生学习古希腊戏剧时来记忆，可以说 **Greek tragedy — “In a world-literature class, students may study how Greek tragedy explores fate, pride, suffering, and moral conflict.”**

quiz.question: ___ __ perfidy
quiz.explanation: 背信弃义; 不忠, 背信弃义的行为. His betrayal was an act of perfidy. 他的背叛是背信弃义的行为。 | per->违背，fid->信任（拉丁fides），perfidy->违背信任=背信弃义（cf. fidelity忠诚，confide信赖，perfidious背信弃义的） || 文化联想：中文“背信弃义”最适合帮助记忆 perfidy，可以说 **an act of perfidy — “Secretly helping an enemy after promising loyalty would be an act of perfidy.”**

quiz.question: _____ subsidy
quiz.explanation: 补贴; 津贴, 国家补贴. Farmers receive a state subsidy for crops. 农民获得农作物的国家补贴。 | sub->从下，sid->坐（拉丁sedere），subsidy->从下面坐着支撑=补贴（cf. subsidize补贴，sediment沉积，preside主持，reside居住） || 文化联想：中国农业里的政府补贴最适合帮助记忆 subsidy，可以说 **a farm subsidy — “A government may provide a farm subsidy to support certain crops or stabilize agricultural production.”**

quiz.question: unwieldy _______
quiz.explanation: 笨重的; 难以处理的, 笨重的包裹. The unwieldy package was difficult to carry. 笨重的包裹很难搬运。 | un->否定，wieldy->可操控的（wield->控制），unwieldy->无法控制的=笨重（cf. wield挥舞，yield屈服，wielder操控者） || 文化联想：中国搬家时遇到又大又难抱的包裹最适合帮助记忆 unwieldy，可以说 **an unwieldy package — “A long, heavy box can be an unwieldy package that is difficult for one person to carry.”**

quiz.question: dandy ______
quiz.explanation: 花花公子; 极好的, 花花公子. The dandy fellow dressed impeccably. 花花公子穿着无可挑剔。 | dandy->花花公子（来自Andy，爱打扮的人名），dandy->注重仪表的人（cf. dapper整洁的，fop花花公子，snazzy时髦的） || 文化联想：民国老上海西装革履、特别爱打扮的公子哥形象最适合帮助记忆 dandy，可以说 **a stylish dandy — “An old Shanghai film may feature a stylish dandy dressed in an immaculate suit and polished shoes.”**

quiz.question: windy ______
quiz.explanation: 多风的; 冗长空洞的, 冗长空洞的演讲. The politician gave a windy speech full of platitudes. 政客发表了充满陈词滥调的冗长空洞演讲。 | wind->风，windy->充满风/空洞的（cf. windfall意外之财，window风眼，long-winded冗长的） || 文化联想：中文“又臭又长、空话连篇的讲话”最适合帮助记忆 windy，可以说 **a windy speech — “A politician may give a windy speech full of slogans but very little concrete information.”**

quiz.question: antibody ____
quiz.explanation: 抗体, 抗体测试. The antibody test detects immunity. 抗体测试检测免疫力。 | anti->对抗，body->身体，antibody->对抗入侵者的身体物质=抗体（cf. antibiotic抗生素，antibiotics=anti+biotic=对抗生命的药） || 文化联想：中国医院做抗体检测最适合帮助记忆 antibody，可以说 **an antibody test — “An antibody test can detect whether the immune system has produced antibodies against a particular target.”**

quiz.question: embody ______
quiz.explanation: 体现; 包含, 体现理想. Heroes embody ideals we admire. 英雄体现了我们钦佩的理想。 | em->使，body->身体，embody->使具有身体=体现（cf. body身体，disembody使无形，embodiment化身，incorporate并入） || 文化联想：梅花常被用来体现坚韧不屈的精神，最适合帮助记忆 embody，可以说 **embody resilience — “In Chinese cultural imagery, plum blossoms can embody resilience because they bloom in the cold of winter.”**

quiz.question: moody ________
quiz.explanation: 喜怒无常的, 喜怒无常的青少年. The moody teenager refused to talk. 喜怒无常的青少年拒绝说话。 | mood->情绪（古英语mod->心情），moody->情绪起伏的=喜怒无常（cf. mood情绪，gloomy阴郁，temperamental性情不定） || 文化联想：中文“青春期孩子情绪阴晴不定”最适合帮助记忆 moody，可以说 **a moody teenager — “A moody teenager may be cheerful in the morning and withdrawn by the evening.”**

quiz.question: __ _ parody
quiz.explanation: 模仿作品; 滑稽模仿, 做滑稽模仿. The comedian will do a parody of the president. 喜剧演员将对总统做滑稽模仿。 | para->旁边，ody->歌曲，parody->在旁边唱的=讽刺模仿（cf. tragedy悲剧，comedy喜剧，ode颂歌，rhapsody狂想曲） || 文化联想：春晚或网络节目里模仿经典影视桥段最适合帮助记忆 parody，可以说 **a comic parody — “A comedy show may perform a comic parody of a famous historical drama by exaggerating its most recognizable scenes.”**

quiz.question: _______ rhapsody
quiz.explanation: 狂想曲; 狂喜, 狂喜的狂想曲. The music put listeners in rapture rhapsody. 音乐使听众陷入狂喜的狂想曲。 | rhaps->缝合（希腊rhaptein->缝），ody->歌曲，rhapsody->缝合诗篇/狂想曲（cf. rapture狂喜，rabid狂热，cf. Bohemian Rhapsody波西米亚狂想曲） || 文化联想：中国音乐学院演奏自由奔放的狂想曲最适合帮助记忆 rhapsody，可以说 **a dramatic rhapsody — “A pianist may perform a dramatic rhapsody that moves freely between lyrical passages and explosive climaxes.”**

quiz.question: ______ custody
quiz.explanation: 监护; 拘留, 警方拘留. The suspect is in police custody. 嫌疑人被警方拘留。 | custod->守卫（拉丁custos->守卫者），custody->守卫下=监护/拘留（cf. custodian管理员，incustody被拘留，guard守卫） || 文化联想：中文“被警方拘留”最适合帮助记忆 custody，可以说 **police custody — “A suspect may remain in police custody while investigators complete required legal procedures.”**

quiz.question: hardy _____
quiz.explanation: 耐寒的; 强壮的, 耐寒植物. This hardy plant survives harsh winters. 这种耐寒植物能在严冬中生存。 | hardy->大胆/强壮（古法语hardi->大胆），hardy->能抵御严酷条件的（cf. bold大胆，sturdy结实，hardship艰难，hard-core核心） || 文化联想：中国北方花园里耐寒植物最适合帮助记忆 hardy，可以说 **a hardy plant — “A hardy plant can survive cold winters and return vigorously in spring.”**

quiz.question: __ jeopardy
quiz.explanation: 危险, 处于危险中. The project is in jeopardy of cancellation. 该项目处于被取消的危险中。 | jeu->游戏（法语），parti->分（Latin），jeopardy->均等的双方=危险的赌局（cf. jeupardi平分游戏，double jeopardy一罪两审） || 文化联想：中文“处在危险境地”最适合帮助记忆 jeopardy，可以说 **in jeopardy — “A project may be in jeopardy if funding disappears just before construction begins.”**

quiz.question: tardy _____
quiz.explanation: 迟到的; 缓慢的, 迟来的回复. His tardy reply arrived too late. 他迟来的回复来得太晚了。 | tard->慢（拉丁tardus->慢），tardy->行动迟缓=迟到的（cf. retard延迟，tardy迟到，tardiness迟缓） || 文化联想：中文“迟迟才回复”最适合帮助记忆 tardy，可以说 **a tardy reply — “A tardy reply to an urgent message can make the sender think the issue was ignored.”**

quiz.question: sturdy _____
quiz.explanation: 结实的; 坚固的, 坚固的框架. The chair has a sturdy frame. 椅子有坚固的框架。 | sturdy->强壮（古法语estourdi->大胆），sturdy->结实强壮的（cf. robust强壮，hardy耐寒，stout粗壮，stalwart坚定） || 文化联想：中国实木家具结实耐用最适合帮助记忆 sturdy，可以说 **a sturdy frame — “A well-made wooden chair needs a sturdy frame that can support years of daily use.”**

quiz.question: _____ understudy
quiz.explanation: 替角; 替补演员, 舞台替补演员. The stage understudy learned all the lines. 舞台替补演员学会了所有台词。 | under->在下，study->学习，understudy->在别人下面学习以备替换=替补演员（cf. underscore强调，undersell低价售出，underlie是基础） || 文化联想：中国剧场里主演生病时替补演员顶上最适合帮助记忆 understudy，可以说 **a stage understudy — “A stage understudy may suddenly perform the leading role when the principal actor becomes ill.”**

quiz.question: bawdy ____
quiz.explanation: 粗俗的; 下流的, 粗俗的笑话. He told a bawdy joke that embarrassed everyone. 他讲了一个粗俗的笑话,让每个人都感到尴尬。 | bawd->妓院老鸨（来自baud->打算），bawdy->与不正经行为有关的=粗俗（cf. lewd下流，ribald粗俗，bawdiness粗俗） || 文化联想：中文“荤笑话、粗俗笑话”最适合帮助记忆 bawdy，可以说 **a bawdy joke — “A comedian at an adults-only show may tell a bawdy joke that would be inappropriate at a family event.”**

quiz.question: dowdy _____

quiz.question: sanctify ___ _____

quiz.question: fructify _____

quiz.question: stultify ______

quiz.question: testify _____ ____

quiz.question: stagy ______

quiz.question: stodgy ____

quiz.question: _______ elegy

quiz.question: _____ horology

quiz.question: _____ paleontology

quiz.question: ____ cytology
quiz.explanation: 细胞学, 细胞细胞学. Cell cytology examines cellular structure. 细胞细胞学检查细胞结构。 | cyto->细胞（希腊kytos），logy->学问，cytology->研究细胞的学问（cf. cytoplasm细胞质，lymphocyte淋巴细胞，eukaryote真核生物） || 文化联想：中国医院细胞学检查最适合帮助记忆 cytology，可以说 **cell cytology — “A laboratory may use cytology to examine individual cells for abnormal changes.”**

quiz.question: _______ _ eulogy
quiz.explanation: 悼词; 颂词, 致悼词. The son will deliver a eulogy at the funeral. 儿子将在葬礼上致悼词。 | eu->好，logy->说，eulogy->说好话=颂词/悼词（cf. euphemism委婉说法，euphoria兴奋，eugenics优生学，elegy挽歌） || 文化联想：中国追悼会上对逝者生平的赞颂最适合帮助记忆 eulogy，可以说 **deliver a eulogy — “A close friend may deliver a eulogy that recalls the character and achievements of the person who died.”**

quiz.question: ______ allergy
quiz.explanation: 过敏, 花生过敏. She has a severe peanut allergy. 她有严重的花生过敏。 | allos->其他（希腊），erg->活动，allergy->对其他物质的过度反应=过敏（cf. energy能量，allergic过敏的，allergen过敏原） || 文化联想：中国学校常见的花生过敏提醒最适合帮助记忆 allergy，可以说 **a peanut allergy — “A child with a severe peanut allergy must avoid foods that may contain traces of peanuts.”**

quiz.question: _____ metallurgy
quiz.explanation: 冶金学, 研究冶金学. Engineers study metallurgy to understand metals. 工程师研究冶金学以了解金属。 | metall->金属（希腊metallon），urgy->工艺，metallurgy->金属工艺的学问（cf. metal金属，metallic金属的，alloy合金） || 文化联想：中国钢铁厂最适合帮助记忆 metallurgy，可以说 **study metallurgy — “An engineering student may study metallurgy to understand how metals are extracted, processed, and strengthened.”**

quiz.question: ______ oligarchy
quiz.explanation: 寡头政治, 统治寡头. The ruling oligarchy controlled all wealth. 统治寡头控制了所有财富。 | oligo->少数（希腊oligos），archy->统治，oligarchy->少数人统治（cf. oligopoly寡头垄断，aristocracy贵族，democracy民主） || 文化联想：oligarchy 是政治学里的“少数人统治”，可用课堂中的权力集中概念来记忆，可以说 **a ruling oligarchy — “A country may be described as a ruling oligarchy when a small elite controls most political power.”**

quiz.question: matriarchy _______
quiz.explanation: 母系社会, 母系社会. The matriarchy society was led by women. 母系社会由女性领导。 | matri->母亲（拉丁mater），archy->统治，matriarchy->母亲统治（cf. patriarch族长，matrix母体，matrimony婚姻=母亲之道） || 文化联想：中文“母系家庭结构”可帮助记忆 matriarchy，但两者不完全等价，可以说 **a matriarchal society — “Anthropologists may describe a society as matriarchal when women hold unusually strong authority in family or social organization.”**

quiz.question: _____ anarchy
quiz.explanation: 无政府状态, 完全无政府状态. The revolution led to total anarchy. 革命导致完全无政府状态。 | an->无，archy->统治，anarchy->无统治=无政府（cf. anarchist无政府主义者，monarchy君主制，hierarchy等级制度） || 文化联想：中文“天下大乱、无人管束”最适合帮助记忆 anarchy，可以说 **total anarchy — “When formal authority collapses completely, a city may descend into total anarchy.”**

quiz.question: ________ monarchy
quiz.explanation: 君主制, 绝对君主制. France had an absolute monarchy before the revolution. 法国在革命前有绝对君主制。 | mono->一人（希腊），archy->统治，monarchy->一人统治=君主制（cf. monopoly垄断，monologue独白，monogamy一夫一妻） || 文化联想：monarchy 是“君主制”，可用中国学生学习欧洲王室制度时来记忆，可以说 **an absolute monarchy — “In an absolute monarchy, the monarch holds very broad governing power.”**

quiz.question: starchy ____
quiz.explanation: 含淀粉的, 含淀粉的食物. Potatoes are starchy food high in carbohydrates. 土豆是碳水化合物含量高的含淀粉食物。 | starch->淀粉（古英语stercan->使硬），starchy->含淀粉的/死板的（cf. starch淀粉，stiff硬的，starchy也指刻板） || 文化联想：中国人吃馒头、米饭这类淀粉多的食物最适合帮助记忆 starchy，可以说 **starchy food — “Rice, noodles, and steamed buns are familiar examples of starchy food.”**

quiz.question: sketchy ____
quiz.explanation: 粗略的; 可疑的, 粗略的计划. The sketchy plan lacked important details. 粗略的计划缺少重要细节。 | sketch->素描（荷兰语schets->轮廓），sketchy->只有轮廓的=粗略/可疑（cf. sketch素描，sketchy design粗略设计，shady可疑） || 文化联想：中文“计划很粗糙、细节不清楚”最适合帮助记忆 sketchy，可以说 **a sketchy plan — “A sketchy plan with no budget or timeline is unlikely to survive serious review.”**

quiz.question: touchy _______
quiz.explanation: 敏感的; 易怒的, 敏感的话题. Politics is a touchy subject at family dinners. 政治在家庭晚餐上是敏感的话题。 | touch->触摸，touchy->一触就跳=敏感的（cf. touch接触，touching感人的，out of touch脱节） || 文化联想：中文“这个话题很敏感，一说就容易翻脸”最适合帮助记忆 touchy，可以说 **a touchy subject — “Family money can become a touchy subject when inheritance is involved.”**

quiz.question: _______ calligraphy
quiz.explanation: 书法, 中国书法. Chinese calligraphy is an ancient art form. 中国书法是一种古老的艺术形式。 | calli->美丽（希腊kalos），graphy->书写，calligraphy->美丽的书写=书法（cf. callisthenics健美操，kaleidoscope万花筒=美丽的形状） || 文化联想：中国毛笔书法最适合帮助记忆 calligraphy，可以说 **Chinese calligraphy — “Chinese calligraphy turns written characters into an art of line, rhythm, and balance.”**

quiz.question: ______ discography
quiz.explanation: 唱片目录, 艺术家唱片目录. The artist discography lists all recordings. 艺术家唱片目录列出所有录音。 | disc->圆盘/唱片（拉丁discus），graphy->记录，discography->唱片的记录=唱片目录（cf. disk磁盘，disco迪斯科，discus铁饼） || 文化联想：中国歌手把多年发行的专辑整理成作品目录最适合帮助记忆 discography，可以说 **an artist’s discography — “A music fan may explore an artist’s discography album by album in chronological order.”**

quiz.question: ______ choreography
quiz.explanation: 编舞; 舞蹈设计, 芭蕾编舞. The ballet choreography was innovative and beautiful. 芭蕾编舞创新且美丽。 | chore->舞蹈（希腊choreia），graphy->记录/设计，choreography->设计舞蹈动作（cf. chorus合唱，choir合唱团，choral合唱的） || 文化联想：中国舞剧编舞最适合帮助记忆 choreography，可以说 **ballet choreography — “A choreographer may design ballet choreography that coordinates every movement with the music.”**

quiz.question: _________ autobiography
quiz.explanation: 自传, 名人自传. The celebrity autobiography became a bestseller. 名人自传成为畅销书。 | auto->自己，bio->生命，graphy->书写，autobiography->自己写自己的生命=自传（cf. biology生物学，biography传记，autobiographical自传的） || 文化联想：中国明星出版自传最适合帮助记忆 autobiography，可以说 **a celebrity autobiography — “A celebrity autobiography may recount childhood, career setbacks, fame, and private turning points.”**

quiz.question: _________ bibliography
quiz.explanation: 参考书目, 注释参考书目. The annotated bibliography explains each source. 注释参考书目解释每个来源。 | biblio->书（希腊biblion），graphy->书写/记录，bibliography->书籍的记录=参考书目（cf. Bible圣经=书，bibliophile爱书人） || 文化联想：中国大学论文最后的参考书目最适合帮助记忆 bibliography，可以说 **an annotated bibliography — “A graduate student may prepare an annotated bibliography that summarizes the value of each source.”**

quiz.question: _____ demography
quiz.explanation: 人口统计学, 研究人口统计学. Sociologists study demography to understand populations. 社会学家研究人口统计学以了解人口。 | demo->人民（希腊demos），graphy->书写/记录，demography->记录人口的学问（cf. democracy民主，epidemic流行病，pandemic全球流行） || 文化联想：中国人口普查数据最适合帮助记忆 demography，可以说 **study demography — “Researchers study demography to understand population size, age structure, migration, births, and deaths.”**

quiz.question: ______ atrophy
quiz.explanation: 萎缩; 衰退, 肌肉萎缩. Inactivity causes muscle atrophy. 不活动会导致肌肉萎缩。 | a->否定，troph->营养（希腊trophe），atrophy->缺乏营养=萎缩（cf. trophy奖杯=营养的成果，hypertrophy过度生长，dystrophy营养不良） || 文化联想：中国医院康复科最熟悉的肌肉萎缩最适合帮助记忆 atrophy，可以说 **muscle atrophy — “Long periods of immobility can lead to muscle atrophy unless strength is gradually rebuilt.”**

quiz.question: splashy _________
quiz.explanation: 引人注目的; 华而不实的, 引人注目的标题. The tabloid used splashy headlines to sell papers. 小报用引人注目的标题来卖报纸。 | splash->溅（象声词），splashy->像水花四溅一样引人注目的（cf. splash溅，splatter飞溅，flashy华而不实） || 文化联想：中文“标题做得很炸眼、特别抢眼”最适合帮助记忆 splashy，可以说 **splashy headlines — “A tabloid may use splashy headlines to attract attention even when the underlying story is ordinary.”**

quiz.question: ______ antipathy
quiz.explanation: 反感; 厌恶, 强烈的反感. He felt strong antipathy toward his rival. 他对对手感到强烈的反感。 | anti->反对，path->感觉（希腊），antipathy->反对的感觉=反感（cf. sympathy同情，empathy共情，apathy冷漠，pathetic可怜的） || 文化联想：中文“打心底里反感”最适合帮助记忆 antipathy，可以说 **strong antipathy — “Years of bitter rivalry can create strong antipathy between two groups.”**

quiz.question: frothy ______
quiz.explanation: 起泡的; 轻浮的, 起泡的咖啡. The cappuccino has frothy coffee foam on top. 卡布奇诺上面有起泡的咖啡泡沫。 | froth->泡沫（古挪威froða），frothy->充满泡沫的=轻浮的（cf. froth泡沫，foam泡沫，frothy empty talk空话） || 文化联想：中国咖啡店奶泡丰富的卡布奇诺最适合帮助记忆 frothy，可以说 **frothy coffee — “A cappuccino topped with thick milk foam can look pleasantly frothy.”**

quiz.question: earthy _____
quiz.explanation: 朴实的; 粗俗的, 朴实的幽默. The comedians earthy humor appealed to many. 喜剧演员朴实的幽默吸引了许多人。 | earth->土地，earthy->像泥土一样朴实/粗俗的（cf. earth地球，earthen陶制的，down-to-earth实际的） || 文化联想：中文“很接地气、带点粗粝真实感”最适合帮助记忆 earthy，可以说 **earthy humor — “A village comedy may use earthy humor drawn from ordinary work, food, and family life.”**

quiz.question: finicky _____
quiz.explanation: 挑剔的; 过分讲究的, 挑剔的食客. The finicky eater refused most foods. 挑剔的食客拒绝大多数食物。 | finicky->过分讲究（可能来自fine->精细），finicky->对细节过分挑剔的（cf. fussy挑剔，picky挑剔，fastidious讲究） || 文化联想：中文“挑食得特别厉害”最适合帮助记忆 finicky，可以说 **a finicky eater — “A finicky eater may reject a dish because the texture is slightly different from what was expected.”**

quiz.question: stocky _____
quiz.explanation: 矮壮的; 结实的, 结实的体格. The wrestler had a stocky build. 摔跤手有结实的体格。 | stock->树干（古英语stocc），stocky->像树干一样粗短的=矮壮的（cf. stock库存/树干，stalwart坚定，stout粗壮，sturdy结实） || 文化联想：中国举重运动员结实敦厚的体格最适合帮助记忆 stocky，可以说 **a stocky build — “A weightlifter may have a stocky build with a broad torso and powerful legs.”**

quiz.question: balky ______
quiz.explanation: 不听使唤的; 倔强的, 不听使唤的引擎. The balky engine refused to start. 不听使唤的引擎拒绝启动。 | balk->障碍（古英语balca->横梁），balky->设置障碍不肯前进的=倔强的（cf. balk阻止/犹豫，obstacle障碍，stubborn固执） || 文化联想：中文“老机器动不动就罢工”最适合帮助记忆 balky，可以说 **a balky engine — “An old tractor with a balky engine may refuse to start on a cold morning.”**

quiz.question: perky ________
quiz.explanation: 活泼的; 神气的, 活泼的态度. She maintained a perky attitude despite setbacks. 尽管遭受挫折,她仍保持活泼的态度。 | perk->精神振作（来源不明），perky->精神奕奕的=活泼的（cf. perk up振作，perky精神的，sprightly活泼，vivacious有活力） || 文化联想：中文“精神头十足、元气满满”最适合帮助记忆 perky，可以说 **a perky attitude — “A perky attitude can make an early morning meeting feel more energetic.”**

quiz.question: pesky _______
quiz.explanation: 讨厌的; 麻烦的, 讨厌的问题. The pesky problem kept recurring. 讨厌的问题不断重现。 | pesky->麻烦的（pest的变体），pesky->像害虫一样令人讨厌的（cf. pest害虫，pesticide杀虫剂，pestilent有害的） || 文化联想：中文“烦人的小毛病、老来打扰”最适合帮助记忆 pesky，可以说 **a pesky problem — “A tiny software bug can become a pesky problem if it keeps returning after every update.”**

quiz.question: frisky _____
quiz.explanation: 活泼的; 爱闹着玩的, 活泼的小狗. The frisky puppy bounced around the yard. 活泼的小狗在院子里蹦蹦跳跳。 | frisk->活蹦乱跳（可能来自frisk->搜身也=快速动作），frisky->精力充沛爱玩耍的（cf. frisk搜身/蹦跳，brisk活跃） || 文化联想：中国小区里活蹦乱跳的小狗最适合帮助记忆 frisky，可以说 **a frisky puppy — “A frisky puppy may race around the courtyard, chase leaves, and demand another game.”**

quiz.question: husky _____
quiz.explanation: 沙哑的; 强壮的, 沙哑的声音. She spoke in a husky voice. 她用沙哑的声音说话。 | husk->外壳（古挪威húss），husky->像外壳一样干燥粗糙=沙哑（cf. husk谷壳，Husky哈士奇犬，hustle推挤） || 文化联想：中文“烟嗓”最适合帮助记忆 husky，可以说 **a husky voice — “A singer with a low, slightly rough tone may have a husky voice.”**

quiz.question: ___________ anomaly
quiz.explanation: 异常; 反常现象, 统计异常. The data showed a statistical anomaly. 数据显示了统计异常。 | an->无，omal->规律（希腊homalos->平坦），anomaly->不符合规律的=异常（cf. anomalous异常的，normal正常，paranormal超自然） || 文化联想：中文“数据里冒出一个反常点”最适合帮助记忆 anomaly，可以说 **a statistical anomaly — “A single result far outside the normal range may be a statistical anomaly worth investigating.”**

quiz.question: unworldly ____
quiz.explanation: 不谙世事的; 超凡脱俗的, 不谙世事的僧侣. The unworldly monk devoted himself to prayer. 不谙世事的僧侣致力于祈祷。 | un->否定，worldly->世俗的，unworldly->不属于世俗的=超凡脱俗（cf. worldly世俗，otherworldly超凡的，naive天真） || 文化联想：中国传统故事里不问世事、远离尘俗的修行者形象最适合帮助记忆 unworldly，可以说 **an unworldly monk — “An unworldly monk in a mountain temple may care little about money, fashion, or worldly status.”**

quiz.question: timely ________
quiz.explanation: 及时的; 适时的, 及时的提醒. The timely reminder helped me meet the deadline. 及时的提醒帮助我按时完成。 | time->时间，ly->形容词后缀，timely->在正确时间的=及时的（cf. untimely过早，timeline时间线，timeless永恒的） || 文化联想：中文“及时雨”最适合帮助记忆 timely，可以说 **a timely reminder — “A timely reminder the day before a deadline can prevent an important task from being forgotten.”**

quiz.question: untimely _____
quiz.explanation: 不合时宜的; 过早的, 过早的死亡. His untimely death shocked everyone. 他过早的死亡震惊了所有人。 | un->否定，timely->适时的，untimely->不在合适时间的=过早的（cf. timely及时，premature过早，inopportune不合时机） || 文化联想：中文“英年早逝”最适合帮助记忆 untimely，可以说 **an untimely death — “The untimely death of a talented young artist may shock an entire community.”**

quiz.question: comely ____
quiz.explanation: 清秀的; 标致的, 清秀的脸. She had a comely face and kind eyes. 她有一张清秀的脸和善良的眼睛。 | comely->美丽（古英语cymlic->精美的），comely->五官端正好看的（cf. becoming合适/好看，handsome英俊，fair美好） || 文化联想：古典小说里常写“眉清目秀”，最适合帮助记忆 comely，可以说 **a comely face — “A historical novel may describe a young woman as having a comely face with clear features and gentle eyes.”**

quiz.question: homely ______
quiz.explanation: 朴实的; 平凡的, 朴实的智慧. The grandmother shared homely wisdom. 祖母分享了朴实的智慧。 | home->家，homely->像家一样朴实的=朴实/相貌平平（cf. homelike像家一样，homespun自织/朴实，cozy舒适） || 文化联想：中文“家常智慧、朴素道理”最适合帮助记忆 homely，可以说 **homely wisdom — “A grandmother may offer homely wisdom about saving money, treating people well, and living within one’s means.”**

quiz.question: ____ contumely
quiz.explanation: 侮辱; 轻蔑, 抛出侮辱. Angry critics hurl contumely at the politician. 愤怒的批评者对政客抛出侮辱。 | contum->傲慢（拉丁contumax），contumely->傲慢地羞辱（cf. contumacious违抗，contumacy抗命，insolent傲慢） || 文化联想：中文“当众羞辱、恶言相加”最适合帮助记忆 contumely，可以说 **hurl contumely — “An angry crowd may hurl contumely at a disgraced official instead of offering reasoned criticism.”**

quiz.question: _____ __ philately
quiz.explanation: 集邮, 集邮爱好. His hobby of philately began in childhood. 他的集邮爱好始于童年。 | philos->热爱，atelia->免税（希腊，邮票=免付邮资的证明），philately->热爱免邮费证明=集邮（cf. philatelist集邮家，philosophy哲学） || 文化联想：中国老一辈人的集邮册最适合帮助记忆 philately，可以说 **a hobby of philately — “A hobby of philately may begin with collecting commemorative stamps issued for major events.”**

quiz.question: _________ gadfly
quiz.explanation: 牛虻; 挑衅者, 政治挑衅者. The political gadfly criticized every policy. 政治挑衅者批评每一项政策。 | gad->刺棒（古挪威gaddr），fly->飞，gadfly->用刺棒刺的飞虫=牛虻/挑衅者（cf. Socrates被称为雅典的gadfly） || 文化联想：苏格拉底“牛虻”这一西方典故可帮助中国学生记忆 gadfly，可以说 **a political gadfly — “A political gadfly constantly challenges officials and forces uncomfortable questions into public debate.”**

quiz.question: earthly _________
quiz.explanation: 尘世的; 世俗的, 尘世的快乐. He renounced earthly pleasures. 他放弃了尘世的快乐。 | earth->地球，ly->形容词，earthly->属于地球/尘世的（cf. unearthly超凡，earthen土制的，down-to-earth实际的） || 文化联想：中文“尘世享乐”最适合帮助记忆 earthly，可以说 **earthly pleasures — “A monk in a traditional story may renounce earthly pleasures such as wealth, luxury, and status.”**

quiz.question: unearthly _______
quiz.explanation: 怪异的; 可怕的, 怪异的寂静. An unearthly silence filled the room. 怪异的寂静充满了房间。 | un->否定，earthly->尘世的，unearthly->不属于尘世的=怪异（cf. supernatural超自然，eerie诡异，uncanny离奇） || 文化联想：深夜老宅突然安静得出奇最适合帮助记忆 unearthly，可以说 **an unearthly silence — “An abandoned courtyard at midnight may fall into an unearthly silence that feels almost supernatural.”**

quiz.question: readily _________

quiz.explanation: 蜂房; 养蜂场, 蜂房. quiz.question: ____ aviary
quiz.explanation: 鸟舍; 大鸟笼, 鸟舍. The bird aviary housed exotic species. 鸟舍饲养了异国物种。 | avi->鸟（拉丁avis），aviary->鸟的居所=鸟舍（cf. aviation航空，aviator飞行员，avifauna鸟类群，auspicious吉祥=鸟兆） || 文化联想：中国动物园的大型鸟舍最适合帮助记忆 aviary，可以说 **a bird aviary — “A large bird aviary may allow visitors to walk among parrots, finches, and other species.”**

quiz.question: ancillary _____
quiz.explanation: 辅助的; 附属的, 辅助人员. Ancillary staff support the main team. 辅助人员支持主要团队。 | ancilla->女奴（拉丁），ancillary->像女奴一样服务的=辅助的（cf. ancilla附属物，auxiliary辅助，subsidiary从属） || 文化联想：中文“辅助人员、配套支持”最适合帮助记忆 ancillary，可以说 **ancillary staff — “Ancillary staff such as technicians and coordinators can keep a hospital department running smoothly.”**

quiz.question: capillary ______
quiz.explanation: 毛细管的, 毛细管作用. Capillary action draws water upward. 毛细管作用向上吸水。 | capill->头发（拉丁capillus），capillary->像头发一样细的管子=毛细管（cf. capital头/首都，capitalize利用，cape海角=头部） || 文化联想：中国物理课里毛细管吸水最适合帮助记忆 capillary，可以说 **capillary action — “Capillary action can draw water upward through a very narrow tube against gravity.”**

quiz.question: exemplary _______
quiz.explanation: 模范的; 典型的, 模范行为. Her exemplary conduct earned praise. 她的模范行为赢得了赞扬。 | exempl->例子（拉丁exemplum），exemplary->作为例子的=模范的（cf. example例子，exemplify举例说明，exempt豁免） || 文化联想：中文“模范行为、值得大家学习”最适合帮助记忆 exemplary，可以说 **exemplary conduct — “A student who returns a lost wallet untouched may be praised for exemplary conduct.”**

quiz.question: customary ________
quiz.explanation: 习惯的; 惯例的, 习惯做法. Its customary practice to shake hands. 握手是习惯做法。 | custom->习俗（拉丁consuetudo），customary->习俗性的（cf. custom习俗，customer顾客，accustom使习惯，customs海关） || 文化联想：春节见长辈拜年属于熟悉的惯例场景，最适合帮助记忆 customary，可以说 **a customary practice — “Visiting older relatives during Spring Festival is a customary practice in many families.”**

quiz.question: canary ______
quiz.explanation: 金丝雀; 淡黄色, 金丝雀黄. She wore a bright canary yellow dress. 她穿着明亮的金丝雀黄连衣裙。 | Canary->加那利群岛（拉丁Canaria->犬岛），canary->加那利群岛上的黄色小鸟（cf. canary yellow金丝雀黄，canine犬的） || 文化联想：金丝雀鲜亮的黄色最适合帮助记忆 canary，可以说 **canary yellow — “A bright canary yellow jacket can stand out immediately in a crowded street.”**

quiz.question: _____ granary
quiz.explanation: 粮仓; 谷仓, 粮仓. The grain granary stores the harvest. 粮仓储存收获的粮食。 | gran->粮食（拉丁granum->谷粒），granary->存储谷粒的地方=粮仓（cf. grain谷粒，granite花岗岩=粒状石，granule颗粒） || 文化联想：中国古代常说“天下粮仓”，最适合帮助记忆 granary，可以说 **a grain granary — “A well-stocked grain granary could help a farming community survive a poor harvest.”**

quiz.question: mercenary _______
quiz.explanation: 雇佣兵; 唯利是图的, 雇佣兵. The mercenary soldier fought for money. 雇佣兵为钱而战。 | merced->报酬（拉丁merces），mercenary->为报酬服务的人=雇佣兵（cf. merchant商人，mercy仁慈=不要报酬，merit功绩） || 文化联想：mercenary 是“为钱作战的雇佣兵”，可用中国学生学习世界军事史来记忆，可以说 **a mercenary soldier — “A mercenary soldier fights primarily for pay rather than loyalty to a particular country.”**

quiz.question: plenary _______
quiz.explanation: 全体的; 全体会议, 全体会议. The plenary session included all members. 全体会议包括所有成员。 | plen->充满/全（拉丁plenus），plenary->全体充满的=全体（cf. plenty充足，replenish补充，supplement补充，complete完整） || 文化联想：中国大型会议里的全体大会最适合帮助记忆 plenary，可以说 **a plenary session — “At a large academic conference, every participant may attend the opening plenary session.”**

quiz.question: interdisciplinary ________
quiz.explanation: 跨学科的, 跨学科研究. Interdisciplinary research combines multiple fields. 跨学科研究结合了多个领域。 | inter->之间，disciplinary->学科的（disciplina->教学），interdisciplinary->在学科之间=跨学科的（cf. discipline纪律，disciple门徒，discipline教导） || 文化联想：中国人工智能研究常结合计算机、数学、语言学等领域，最适合帮助记忆 interdisciplinary，可以说 **interdisciplinary research — “Modern AI often requires interdisciplinary research combining computer science, mathematics, linguistics, and cognitive science.”**

quiz.question: culinary ____
quiz.explanation: 烹饪的, 烹饪艺术. He studied culinary arts at a prestigious school. 他在一所著名学校学习烹饪艺术。 | culina->厨房（拉丁），culinary->厨房相关的=烹饪的（cf. kiln窑炉，culinary art烹饪艺术，cuisine菜系） || 文化联想：淮扬菜讲究刀工、火候与摆盘的完整厨艺体系最适合帮助记忆 culinary，可以说 **culinary arts — “A chef studying Huaiyang cuisine may spend years mastering the culinary arts of cutting, seasoning, cooking, and presentation.”**

quiz.question: _________ seminary
quiz.explanation: 神学院; 学院, 宗教神学院. He attended a religious seminary to become a priest. 他参加了宗教神学院成为牧师。 | semin->种子（拉丁semen），seminary->播种知识的地方=神学院（cf. seminal开创性的，inseminate播种，semen精液） || 文化联想：seminary 是基督教神学院，可用中国学生参观教会学校或学习世界宗教时来记忆，可以说 **a religious seminary — “A student studying Christianity may learn that a religious seminary trains people for ministry and theological work.”**

quiz.question: preliminary _____
quiz.explanation: 初步的; 预备的, 预赛. The team advanced past the preliminary round. 球队通过了预赛。 | pre->之前，limin->门槛（拉丁limen），preliminary->越过门槛之前的=预备的（cf. eliminate淘汰=踢出门槛，subliminal阈下的） || 文化联想：中国体育比赛先打预赛再进决赛最适合帮助记忆 preliminary，可以说 **a preliminary round — “A young table-tennis player must survive the preliminary round before entering the main competition.”**

quiz.question: ________ luminary
quiz.explanation: 杰出人物; 名人, 行业名人. An industry luminary gave the keynote speech. 一位行业名人发表了主题演讲。 | lumin->光（拉丁lumen），luminary->发光者=杰出人物（cf. illuminate照亮，luminous发光的，lumen流明，lunar月亮的） || 文化联想：钱学森这类在专业领域具有巨大影响力的杰出人物最适合帮助记忆 luminary，可以说 **a scientific luminary — “A scientific luminary can shape an entire field through influential research, teaching, and leadership.”**

quiz.question: veterinary ______
quiz.explanation: 兽医的, 兽医诊所. Take your pet to the veterinary clinic. 把你的宠物带到兽医诊所。 | veter->老/经验丰富（拉丁vetus），veterinary->治疗老/役畜的=兽医（cf. veteran老兵，inveterate根深蒂固，veto否决权） || 文化联想：中国城市里给猫狗看病的宠物医院最适合帮助记忆 veterinary，可以说 **a veterinary clinic — “A family may take a sick cat to a veterinary clinic for examination and treatment.”**

quiz.question: visionary ______
quiz.explanation: 有远见的; 空想家, 有远见的领导者. The visionary leader transformed the company. 有远见的领导者改变了公司。 | vis->看（拉丁videre），visionary->能看到未来的人=有远见的（cf. vision视觉，visible可见，supervise监督，television电视） || 文化联想：中文“有远见、能看到未来趋势”最适合帮助记忆 visionary，可以说 **a visionary leader — “A visionary leader may invest in a new technology years before most competitors recognize its importance.”**

quiz.question: stationary ____
quiz.explanation: 静止的; 固定的, 固定自行车. She exercises on a stationary bike. 她在固定自行车上锻炼。 | statio->站立（拉丁stare），stationary->固定站立不动的（注意区分stationery文具，cf. station站，statue雕像） || 文化联想：中国健身房里原地骑但车身不移动的单车最适合帮助记忆 stationary，可以说 **a stationary bike — “A gym member can pedal hard on a stationary bike while remaining in exactly the same place.”**

quiz.question: reactionary ______
quiz.explanation: 反动的; 保守的, 反动势力. Reactionary forces opposed the reforms. 反动势力反对改革。 | reaction->反应，ary->倾向于，reactionary->倾向于向后反应的=反动的（cf. react反应，revolutionary革命的，progressive进步的） || 文化联想：reactionary 是政治史里的“反动、极端守旧”概念，可用中国学生学习近现代史时来记忆，可以说 **reactionary forces — “In a history class, students may read about reactionary forces that resist reform and try to restore an older political order.”**

quiz.question: _____ functionary
quiz.explanation: 公务员; 官员, 党务官员. The party functionary attended all meetings. 党务官员参加了所有会议。 | function->职能（拉丁fungi->执行），functionary->执行职能的人=官员（cf. function功能，defunct停止，malfunction故障） || 文化联想：中文“按职务办事的官员”最适合帮助记忆 functionary，可以说 **an administrative functionary — “An administrative functionary may carry out routine duties according to established rules rather than set policy personally.”**

quiz.question: discretionary ________
quiz.explanation: 自由支配的; 任意的, 可自由支配的开支. The budget includes discretionary spending. 预算包括可自由支配的开支。 | discret->分辨/判断（拉丁discernere），discretionary->依判断决定的（cf. discreet谨慎，discrete分离的，discretion酌情） || 文化联想：中国家庭预算里“旅游、娱乐、升级电子产品”属于可自由决定的部分，最适合帮助记忆 discretionary，可以说 **discretionary spending — “A family can cut discretionary spending on travel and entertainment when it needs to save more money.”**

quiz.question: cautionary ____
quiz.explanation: 警告的; 告诫的, 警世故事. The movie serves as a cautionary tale. 这部电影是一个警世故事。 | caution->谨慎（拉丁cautio），cautionary->起警告作用的（cf. caution警告，precaution预防，incautious不谨慎） || 文化联想：“守株待兔”这类用故事提醒人不要犯同样错误的寓言最适合帮助记忆 cautionary，可以说 **a cautionary tale — “The story can serve as a cautionary tale about relying on luck instead of adapting to changing circumstances.”**

quiz.question: hoary ______
quiz.explanation: 灰白的; 古老的, 古老的传说. The hoary legend has been told for centuries. 古老的传说已流传了几个世纪。 | hoary->白发（古英语har->灰白），hoary->灰白头发的=古老的（cf. hoarfrost白霜，hoary old joke陈年老笑话，gray灰） || 文化联想：中文“陈年老传说”最适合帮助记忆 hoary，可以说 **a hoary legend — “A hoary legend repeated for centuries may survive even after nobody remembers where it began.”**

quiz.question: ______ itinerary
quiz.explanation: 旅行计划; 路线, 旅行行程. The travel itinerary includes five countries. 旅行行程包括五个国家。 | iter->旅程（拉丁iter->道路），itinerary->旅程的记录=行程（cf. itinerant流动的，reiterate重复，exit出口=出去的路） || 文化联想：中国游客出发前把每天城市、酒店和景点排好的行程表最适合帮助记忆 itinerary，可以说 **a travel itinerary — “A traveler may prepare a travel itinerary listing each day’s train, hotel, and sightseeing plans.”**

quiz.question: ______ emissary
quiz.explanation: 使者; 密使, 秘密使者. A secret emissary delivered the message. 一位秘密使者传递了信息。 | emiss->派出（拉丁emittere），emissary->被派出的人=使者（cf. emit发射，emission排放，missile导弹=被发射的，mission任务） || 文化联想：古装剧里秘密奉命出使传信的人最适合帮助记忆 emissary，可以说 **a secret emissary — “A ruler in a historical drama may send a secret emissary to deliver a private message to an ally.”**

quiz.question: glossary _____
quiz.explanation: 术语表; 词汇表, 术语表术语. The glossary terms are defined at the back. 术语表术语在后面定义。 | gloss->注释（希腊glossa->语言），glossary->词语注释的汇编=词汇表（cf. gloss光泽/注释，glossy光亮的，polyglot多语言） || 文化联想：中国技术教材最后专门解释专业词汇的一页最适合帮助记忆 glossary，可以说 **a technical glossary — “A textbook may include a technical glossary that defines unfamiliar terms for beginners.”**

quiz.question: proprietary ________
quiz.explanation: 专有的; 私有的, 专有软件. The company uses proprietary software. 公司使用专有软件。 | propri->自己的（拉丁proprius），proprietary->属于所有者的=专有的（cf. proper适当的，property财产，appropriate挪用/适当） || 文化联想：公司内部不公开源代码、只有授权用户能使用的软件最适合帮助记忆 proprietary，可以说 **proprietary software — “A company may rely on proprietary software whose source code and license are controlled by a single owner.”**

quiz.question: monetary ______
quiz.explanation: 货币的; 金融的, 货币政策. The central bank sets monetary policy. 中央银行制定货币政策。 | moneta->铸币（拉丁，Juno Moneta女神），monetary->货币相关的（cf. money金钱，mint铸币厂，monitor警告=朱诺女神在警告） || 文化联想：中文“货币政策”最适合帮助记忆 monetary，可以说 **monetary policy — “A central bank can use monetary policy to influence interest rates, credit conditions, and inflation.”**

quiz.question: hereditary _______
quiz.explanation: 遗传的; 世袭的, 遗传性疾病. Hemophilia is a hereditary disease. 血友病是遗传性疾病。 | hered->继承（拉丁heres->继承人），hereditary->通过继承传递的（cf. inherit继承，heir继承人，heritage遗产） || 文化联想：中国医院问诊时常会询问家族病史，最适合帮助记忆 hereditary，可以说 **a hereditary disease — “A doctor may ask about relatives because a hereditary disease can be passed from one generation to the next.”**

quiz.question: solitary ___________
quiz.explanation: 单独的; 孤独的, 单独监禁. The prisoner was placed in solitary confinement. 囚犯被单独监禁。 | solit->单独（拉丁solus->孤独），solitary->独自一人的（cf. solo独奏，solitude孤独，sole唯一，sole脚底） || 文化联想：中文“单独监禁、与其他人完全隔离”最适合帮助记忆 solitary，可以说 **solitary confinement — “A prisoner in solitary confinement is kept apart from the general prison population.”**

quiz.question: sanitary __________
quiz.explanation: 卫生的; 清洁的, 卫生条件. The restaurant maintains sanitary conditions. 餐厅保持卫生条件。 | sanit->健康（拉丁sanitas），sanitary->保持健康清洁的（cf. sane清醒，sanitize消毒，insane疯狂，sanatorium疗养院） || 文化联想：中国餐馆后厨检查最看重清洁、消毒和食品保存，最适合帮助记忆 sanitary，可以说 **sanitary conditions — “A restaurant must maintain sanitary conditions in its kitchen to reduce the risk of contamination.”**

quiz.question: ________ dignitary
quiz.explanation: 显要人物; 高官, 来访显要. The visiting dignitary received a warm welcome. 来访显要受到热烈欢迎。 | dignit->尊严（拉丁dignitas），dignitary->有尊严地位的人=显要（cf. dignity尊严，dignified庄重，condescend屈尊，indignation愤慨） || 文化联想：国际会议机场迎宾时隆重接待的重要来宾最适合帮助记忆 dignitary，可以说 **a visiting dignitary — “Officials may arrange a formal reception for a visiting dignitary arriving for an international conference.”**

quiz.question: complementary ______
quiz.explanation: 互补的; 补充的, 互补色. Red and green are complementary colors. 红色和绿色是互补色。 | complet->填满（拉丁），complementary->互相填满缺口的（注意区分complimentary赞美的，cf. complete完整，supplement补充） || 文化联想：中国美术课堂学习红绿、蓝橙等互补关系最适合帮助记忆 complementary，可以说 **complementary colors — “An art student may place complementary colors side by side to create strong visual contrast.”**

quiz.question: rudimentary ______
quiz.explanation: 基本的; 初步的, 基本技能. He has only rudimentary skills in cooking. 他只有烹饪的基本技能。 | rudiment->最初的学习（拉丁rudis->粗糙未加工），rudimentary->最初级的（cf. rude粗鲁/原始，erudite博学=去除粗糙，rudiment基础） || 文化联想：刚学毛笔字只会基本握笔和横竖撇捺最适合帮助记忆 rudimentary，可以说 **rudimentary skills — “A beginner in calligraphy may have only rudimentary skills in brush control and basic strokes.”**

quiz.question: alimentary _____
quiz.explanation: 营养的; 消化的, 消化道. The alimentary canal processes food. 消化道处理食物。 | aliment->食物（拉丁alimentum），alimentary->与食物营养相关的（cf. alimony赡养费，alimentation进食，nourish滋养） || 文化联想：中国医学院解剖课里的“消化道”最适合帮助记忆 alimentary，可以说 **the alimentary canal — “The alimentary canal carries food through the digestive system from the mouth onward.”**

quiz.question: ______ commentary
quiz.explanation: 评论; 注释, 体育评论. The sports commentary was entertaining. 体育评论很有趣。 | comment->评注（拉丁commentari->仔细思考），commentary->对事件的持续评注（cf. comment评论，commend赞扬，commence开始） || 文化联想：央视或其他体育频道边比赛边解说最适合帮助记忆 commentary，可以说 **sports commentary — “Good sports commentary explains tactics and key moments while the match is unfolding.”**

quiz.question: involuntary ______
quiz.explanation: 非自愿的; 无意识的, 非自愿抽搐. He had an involuntary twitch in his eye. 他的眼睛有非自愿抽搐。 | in->否定，voluntary->自愿的（拉丁velle->愿意），involuntary->非自愿的（cf. volunteer自愿者，volition意志，benevolent善意） || 文化联想：中文“眼皮不受控制地跳一下”最适合帮助记忆 involuntary，可以说 **an involuntary twitch — “Fatigue or stress can sometimes cause an involuntary twitch around the eye.”**

quiz.question: votary __ ___
quiz.explanation: 信徒; 热心者, 艺术热心者. She is a devoted votary of art. 她是艺术的忠实热心者。 | vot->誓言（拉丁votum），votary->发誓献身的人=信徒/热心者（cf. vote投票，devout虔诚，devote奉献，votive还愿的） || 文化联想：在敦煌艺术保护中一生投入研究与保存的人可以帮助记忆 votary，可以说 **a votary of art — “A conservator who devotes an entire career to preserving Dunhuang murals could be described as a votary of art.”**

quiz.question: _____ tributary
quiz.explanation: 支流; 进贡国, 河流支流. The river tributary flows into the main stream. 河流支流流入主河道。 | tribut->给予（拉丁tribuere），tributary->向主河流贡献水流的（cf. tribute贡物，contribute贡献，distribute分发，attribute归因） || 文化联想：嘉陵江汇入长江的地理关系最适合帮助记忆 tributary，可以说 **a major tributary — “The Jialing River is a major tributary that flows into the Yangtze at Chongqing.”**

quiz.question: salutary ______
quiz.explanation: 有益的; 有用的, 有益的教训. The failure taught a salutary lesson. 失败教会了有益的教训。 | salut->健康（拉丁salus），salutary->有益于健康/改善的（cf. salute敬礼=祝平安，salubrious有益健康，salutation问候） || 文化联想：中文“吃一堑长一智”最适合帮助记忆 salutary，可以说 **a salutary lesson — “A costly mistake can become a salutary lesson if it changes how future decisions are made.”**

quiz.question: ______ statuary
quiz.explanation: 雕像; 雕塑, 大理石雕像.
