quiz.question: ______ __ inquiry
quiz.explanation: 调查; 询问, 发起调查. Officials will launch an inquiry into the matter. 官员将对此事发起调查。 | in->进入，quiry->寻找（拉丁quaerere），inquiry->深入寻找=调查（cf. query询问，acquire获取，inquest调查审讯） || 文化联想：中文“成立调查组、正式展开调查”最适合帮助记忆 inquiry，可以说 **launch an inquiry — “Officials may launch an inquiry after a serious construction accident to determine what went wrong.”**

quiz.question: cavalry ______
quiz.explanation: 骑兵, 骑兵冲锋. The cavalry charge was decisive. 骑兵冲锋是决定性的。 | caval->马（法语cheval，拉丁caballus），cavalry->骑马的军队=骑兵（cf. cavalier骑士，chivalry骑士精神，cavalcade骑马游行） || 文化联想：中国古代骑兵冲锋的战场画面最适合帮助记忆 cavalry，可以说 **a cavalry charge — “In a historical battle, mounted soldiers may launch a cavalry charge across open ground.”**

quiz.question: ______ rivalry
quiz.explanation: 竞争; 对抗, 市场竞争. Market rivalry drives innovation. 市场竞争推动创新。 | rival->竞争者（拉丁rivalis->用同一河流的人），rivalry->相互竞争的状态（cf. rival对手，derive源自，river河=大家争的资源） || 文化联想：中国电商平台争夺用户、商家和流量最适合帮助记忆 rivalry，可以说 **market rivalry — “Intense market rivalry can push competing e-commerce platforms to lower fees and improve service.”**

quiz.question: _____ revelry
quiz.explanation: 狂欢; 欢闹, 喧闹的狂欢. Noisy revelry continued until dawn. 喧闹的狂欢持续到黎明。 | revel->狂欢（古法语reveler->叛逆/狂欢），revelry->放纵狂欢（cf. rebel叛逆，revelation启示，revel沉迷于） || 文化联想：春节跨年夜街头锣鼓、人群和欢呼最适合帮助记忆 revelry，可以说 **noisy revelry — “Noisy revelry may continue late into the night during a large New Year celebration.”**

quiz.question: _____ allegory
quiz.explanation: 寓言; 讽喻, 道德寓言. The story is a moral allegory about greed. 这个故事是关于贪婪的道德寓言。 | allos->其他（希腊），agory->说（希腊agoreuein->在广场演讲），allegory->用其他方式说出=寓言（cf. category类别，allegory隐喻故事） || 文化联想：“愚公移山”可以作为坚持不懈的寓意故事来帮助记忆 allegory，可以说 **a moral allegory — “The story of Yu the Great or the Foolish Old Man can be read as a moral allegory about persistence and human determination.”**

quiz.question: ______ pillory
quiz.explanation: 颈手枷; 示众, 公开示众. Critics put him in the public pillory. 批评者让他公开示众。 | pillar->柱子（拉丁pila），pillory->固定在柱子上示众的枷=颈手枷（cf. pillar支柱，pillory公开羞辱，milestone里程碑） || 文化联想：中文“被公开钉在耻辱柱上”最适合帮助记忆 pillory，可以说 **a public pillory — “A company exposed for serious fraud may face a public pillory in the press and on social media.”**

quiz.question: _______ armory
quiz.explanation: 军械库; 兵工厂, 武器库. The weapons armory stores military equipment. 武器库储存军事装备。 | arma->武器（拉丁），armory->存储武器的地方（cf. arm手臂/武装，army军队，armor盔甲，armada舰队） || 文化联想：古代王府或军营专门存放兵器的库房最适合帮助记忆 armory，可以说 **a weapons armory — “A palace guard might keep swords, bows, armor, and other equipment in a secured weapons armory.”**

quiz.question: provisory ________
quiz.explanation: 临时的; 暂时的, 临时合同. They signed a provisory contract. 他们签署了临时合同。 | provis->预见（拉丁providere），provisory->依条件而定的=临时的（cf. provide提供，provision供应，improvise即兴=未事先准备） || 文化联想：provisory 表示“暂定的、临时的”，可用中国商务谈判先签暂行协议来记忆，可以说 **a provisory contract — “Two companies may sign a provisory contract while lawyers continue negotiating the final terms.”**

quiz.question: compulsory _________
quiz.explanation: 强制的; 义务的, 义务教育. Compulsory education is required by law. 法律规定义务教育。 | compuls->强迫（拉丁compellere），compulsory->被强迫的（cf. compel强迫，impulse冲动，repulse击退，pulse脉冲） || 文化联想：中国“九年义务教育”最适合帮助记忆 compulsory，可以说 **compulsory education — “China’s system of compulsory education requires children to receive a defined period of basic schooling.”**

quiz.question: cursory ______
quiz.explanation: 粗略的; 草率的, 粗略的一瞥. He gave the document a cursory glance. 他对文件粗略地看了一眼。 | curs->奔跑（拉丁currere），cursory->匆忙跑过的=粗略的（cf. course路线，cursor光标，currency流通货币，excursion远足） || 文化联想：中文“走马观花地看一眼”最适合帮助记忆 cursory，可以说 **a cursory glance — “A rushed inspector may give the document only a cursory glance and miss an important detail.”**

quiz.question: _______ accessory
quiz.explanation: 附件; 配件, 时尚配件. She bought a fashion accessory to match her dress. 她买了一个时尚配件来搭配她的连衣裙。 | ac->朝向，cess->走（拉丁cedere），accessory->走向旁边的=附件/同谋（cf. access进入，necessary必要，exceed超出） || 文化联想：玉佩、丝巾等可作为服装搭配的小物件最适合帮助记忆 accessory，可以说 **a fashion accessory — “A jade pendant can serve as a fashion accessory as well as a culturally meaningful ornament.”**

quiz.question: illusory ____
quiz.explanation: 虚幻的; 错觉的, 虚幻的希望. The promise proved to be illusory hope. 承诺被证明是虚幻的希望。 | illus->欺骗（拉丁illudere->嘲弄），illusory->像幻觉一样的=虚幻的（cf. illusion幻觉，allusion暗示，delusion妄想） || 文化联想：“镜花水月”最适合帮助记忆 illusory，可以说 **an illusory hope — “A plan based entirely on impossible assumptions may create an illusory hope of easy success.”**

quiz.question: mandatory _______
quiz.explanation: 强制的; 法定的, 强制性会议. Attendance at the mandatory meeting is required. 必须出席强制性会议。 | mandat->命令（拉丁mandatum->委托），mandatory->被命令的=强制的（cf. mandate命令，command命令，demand要求，commend赞扬） || 文化联想：中国公司要求全员参加的会议最适合帮助记忆 mandatory，可以说 **a mandatory meeting — “Employees may be required to attend a mandatory meeting about workplace safety.”**

quiz.question: obligatory ____
quiz.explanation: 义务的; 必须的, 义务职责. Military service is an obligatory duty. 服兵役是义务职责。 | oblig->绑定（拉丁obligare），obligatory->被绑定的=必须的（cf. oblige迫使，obligation义务，ligate扎紧，ligament韧带） || 文化联想：中文“该做就必须做的职责”最适合帮助记忆 obligatory，可以说 **an obligatory duty — “Submitting required tax documents can be an obligatory duty rather than a matter of personal preference.”**

quiz.question: derogatory ______
quiz.explanation: 贬损的; 轻蔑的, 贬损的评论. He made a derogatory remark about her work. 他对她的工作做出了贬损的评论。 | de->向下，rogat->询问/提议（拉丁），derogatory->向下提议削减=贬损（cf. abrogate废除，arrogate僭取，interrogate审讯） || 文化联想：中文“带贬低意味的话”最适合帮助记忆 derogatory，可以说 **a derogatory remark — “Mocking someone’s accent with a derogatory remark can be insulting and discriminatory.”**

quiz.question: purgatory ____
quiz.explanation: 炼狱, 炼狱之火. Souls suffer in purgatory fire. 灵魂在炼狱之火中受苦。 | purg->清洗（拉丁purgare），purgatory->清洗罪孽的地方=炼狱（cf. purge清除，pure纯洁，expurgate删除，purify净化） || 文化联想：purgatory 是天主教“炼狱”概念，可用中国学生学习世界宗教时来记忆，可以说 **the fires of purgatory — “In Catholic teaching, purgatory is understood as a state of purification before heaven.”**

quiz.question: nugatory _______
quiz.explanation: 无价值的; 无效的, 无价值的开支. The nugatory expense was a waste of money. 无价值的开支是浪费金钱。 | nugat->无价值（拉丁nugari->说废话），nugatory->毫无价值的（cf. nugget金块，negligible可忽略，null无效） || 文化联想：中文“花了钱却一点作用都没有”最适合帮助记忆 nugatory，可以说 **a nugatory expense — “Paying repeatedly for a report that nobody reads can become a nugatory expense with no practical effect.”**

quiz.question: conciliatory _______
quiz.explanation: 安抚的; 和解的, 和解的姿态. He made a conciliatory gesture to end the dispute. 他做出了和解的姿态来结束争端。 | concili->调解（拉丁conciliare->使和解），conciliatory->旨在和解的（cf. council理事会，counsel建议，reconcile调和） || 文化联想：邻里争执时先主动道歉、递出和解信号最适合帮助记忆 conciliatory，可以说 **a conciliatory gesture — “Offering to meet halfway can be a conciliatory gesture that helps calm a neighborhood dispute.”**

quiz.question: dilatory _______
quiz.explanation: 拖延的; 延误的, 拖延战术. The lawyer used dilatory tactics in court. 律师在法庭上使用拖延战术。 | dilat->拖延（拉丁dilatio->延迟），dilatory->造成延迟的（cf. delay延迟，dilate扩张，late晚，dilatory tactics拖延战术） || 文化联想：中文“拖字诀”最适合帮助记忆 dilatory，可以说 **dilatory tactics — “A committee may use dilatory tactics by repeatedly postponing a decision it does not want to make.”**

quiz.question: ambulatory _______
quiz.explanation: 能走动的; 流动的, 能走动的病人. The ambulatory patient can walk without assistance. 能走动的病人可以独立行走。 | ambul->行走（拉丁ambulare），ambulatory->能够行走的（cf. ambulance救护车，amble漫步，preamble序言=行走之前） || 文化联想：中国医院里可以下床行走、不需卧床监护的病人最适合帮助记忆 ambulatory，可以说 **an ambulatory patient — “An ambulatory patient can walk independently and may not need continuous bed care.”**

quiz.question: ______ signatory
quiz.explanation: 签署者; 签约国, 条约签署者. All treaty signatory nations must comply. 所有条约签署国必须遵守。 | sign->标记/签名（拉丁signum），signatory->在文件上签名的=签署者（cf. sign标志，signal信号，signature签名，design设计） || 文化联想：中国学生学习国际条约时最适合帮助记忆 signatory，可以说 **a treaty signatory — “A treaty signatory is a country or party that has formally signed the agreement.”**

quiz.question: minatory ____
quiz.explanation: 威胁的; 恐吓的, 威胁的语气. He spoke in a minatory tone. 他用威胁的语气说话。 | minat->威胁（拉丁minari），minatory->充满威胁的（cf. menace威胁，ominous不祥，threatening威胁性的，minatory=threatening） || 文化联想：中文“带威胁意味的口气”最适合帮助记忆 minatory，可以说 **a minatory tone — “A debt collector who speaks in a minatory tone may make the listener feel threatened.”**

quiz.question: discriminatory ________
quiz.explanation: 歧视性的, 歧视性做法. The discriminatory practice was ruled illegal. 歧视性做法被裁定为非法。 | discrimin->区分（拉丁discriminare），discriminatory->通过区分进行歧视的（cf. discriminate区分，crime犯罪，crisp清晰） || 文化联想：招聘中因为性别、年龄或其他无关特征区别对待最适合帮助记忆 discriminatory，可以说 **a discriminatory practice — “Rejecting qualified applicants solely because of an irrelevant personal characteristic can be a discriminatory practice.”**

quiz.question: anticipatory ____
quiz.explanation: 预期的; 先发的, 预期保释. The court granted anticipatory bail. 法院批准了预期保释。 | anti->提前，cipat->抓取（拉丁capere），anticipatory->提前抓取=预期的（cf. anticipate预料，participate参与，emancipate解放） || 文化联想：anticipatory bail 是印度等法域使用的法律概念，可用中国法学生学习比较法时来记忆，可以说 **anticipatory bail — “In a comparative-law class, a student may learn that anticipatory bail can protect a person from immediate arrest under certain legal systems.”**

quiz.question: migratory _____
quiz.explanation: 迁徙的; 流动的, 候鸟. Migratory birds fly south for winter. 候鸟为过冬飞往南方。 | migrat->迁徙（拉丁migrare），migratory->迁移的（cf. migrate迁徙，emigrate移民出，immigrate移民入，transmigration轮回） || 文化联想：鄱阳湖每年迎来大量候鸟越冬最适合帮助记忆 migratory，可以说 **migratory birds — “Poyang Lake attracts large numbers of migratory birds that arrive seasonally along major flyways.”**

quiz.question: ________ oratory
quiz.explanation: 演讲术; 雄辩, 有力的演讲. His powerful oratory moved the audience. 他有力的演讲打动了观众。 | orat->说话（拉丁orare），oratory->演讲的技艺（cf. orator演说家，oral口语的，oration演说，orator vs demagogue） || 文化联想：中国学校演讲比赛里慷慨激昂的演说最适合帮助记忆 oratory，可以说 **powerful oratory — “A skilled student speaker may use powerful oratory to hold the audience’s attention throughout a debate.”**

quiz.question: compensatory _______
quiz.explanation: 补偿的; 赔偿的, 赔偿金. The court awarded compensatory damages. 法院裁定赔偿金。 | compens->秤重平衡（拉丁compensare），compensatory->用于平衡损失的（cf. compensation赔偿，pension养老金，spend花费） || 文化联想：中文民事诉讼里“补偿性赔偿”最适合帮助记忆 compensatory，可以说 **compensatory damages — “A court may award compensatory damages to repay a person for proven financial loss or injury.”**

quiz.question: gustatory _________
quiz.explanation: 味觉的, 味觉感受器. Gustatory receptors detect flavors. 味觉感受器检测味道。 | gust->品味（拉丁gustus），gustatory->与品味味觉相关的（cf. gusto热情，disgust厌恶，robust强壮=充满活力如美食） || 文化联想：中国生物课学习舌头上的味觉感受器最适合帮助记忆 gustatory，可以说 **gustatory receptors — “Gustatory receptors help the nervous system detect different taste-related chemicals in food.”**

quiz.question: _____ observatory
quiz.explanation: 天文台; 观测站, 太空观测站. The space observatory monitors distant galaxies. 太空观测站监测遥远的星系。 | observ->观察（拉丁observare），observatory->用于观察的建筑=观测站（cf. observe观察，observation观察，conserve保存） || 文化联想：北京古观象台或现代天文台最适合帮助记忆 observatory，可以说 **an astronomical observatory — “An astronomical observatory uses specialized instruments to study stars, planets, and other objects in the sky.”**

quiz.question: _____ conservatory
quiz.explanation: 温室; 音乐学院, 玻璃温室. The glass conservatory houses tropical plants. 玻璃温室容纳热带植物。 | conserv->保存（拉丁conservare），conservatory->保存植物/音乐的地方（cf. conserve保存，conservation保护，preserve保护） || 文化联想：中国大型植物园里的玻璃温室最适合帮助记忆 conservatory，可以说 **a glass conservatory — “A botanical garden may use a glass conservatory to protect tropical plants through a cold northern winter.”**

quiz.question: olfactory _____
quiz.explanation: 嗅觉的, 嗅神经. The olfactory nerve detects smells. 嗅神经检测气味。 | olfact->嗅（拉丁olfacere->闻嗅），olfactory->与嗅觉相关的（cf. olfaction嗅觉，smell嗅觉，gustatory味觉） || 文化联想：中国医学院解剖课里的嗅神经最适合帮助记忆 olfactory，可以说 **the olfactory nerve — “The olfactory nerve carries smell-related information from the nose toward the brain.”**

quiz.question: refractory _____
quiz.explanation: 难熔的; 倔强的, 难熔金属. Refractory metal withstands high temperatures. 难熔金属耐高温。 | re->对抗，fract->破（拉丁frangere），refractory->对抗破碎/管理=难控制的（cf. refract折射，fracture骨折，infract违反） || 文化联想：中国航天和高温工业常用钨等耐高温金属最适合帮助记忆 refractory，可以说 **a refractory metal — “Tungsten is a refractory metal valued for retaining strength at extremely high temperatures.”**

quiz.question: _______ refectory
quiz.explanation: 食堂; 餐厅, 大学食堂. Students eat in the college refectory. 学生在大学食堂吃饭。 | re->再次，fect->做/修复（拉丁reficere->恢复），refectory->恢复体力的地方=食堂（cf. perfect完美，affect影响，defect缺陷） || 文化联想：寺院里僧众共同用餐的食堂最适合帮助记忆 refectory，可以说 **a monastery refectory — “Monks may gather in a monastery refectory for simple communal meals at fixed times each day.”**

quiz.question: ______ trajectory
quiz.explanation: 轨迹; 弹道, 飞行轨迹. The flight trajectory was carefully calculated. 飞行轨迹被仔细计算。 | traject->投掷穿越（拉丁trajectus，trans+jacere->投），trajectory->投掷物经过的路径（cf. project投影，inject注射，reject拒绝） || 文化联想：神舟飞船升空后沿着精确计算的路径飞行，最适合帮助记忆 trajectory，可以说 **a flight trajectory — “Engineers carefully calculate a spacecraft’s flight trajectory from launch through reentry.”**

quiz.question: contradictory _________
quiz.explanation: 矛盾的; 对立的, 矛盾的陈述. The witness made a contradictory statement. 证人做出了矛盾的陈述。 | contra->对抗，dict->说（拉丁dicere），contradictory->反向说的=矛盾的（cf. predict预言，dictate命令，verdict裁决） || 文化联想：中文“前后自相矛盾”最适合帮助记忆 contradictory，可以说 **a contradictory statement — “A witness who gives two incompatible accounts has made a contradictory statement.”**

quiz.question: valedictory _______
quiz.explanation: 告别的; 告别演说, 告别演说. The senior gave the valedictory address. 高年级学生发表了告别演说。 | vale->再见（拉丁vale->保重），dict->说，valedictory->说再见的=告别演说（cf. valedictorian告别致辞者，farewell告别） || 文化联想：中国大学毕业典礼上的告别致辞最适合帮助记忆 valedictory，可以说 **a valedictory address — “A graduating student may deliver a valedictory address that looks back on school life and says farewell.”**

quiz.question: perfunctory ___
quiz.explanation: 敷衍的; 例行公事的, 敷衍的点头. He gave a perfunctory nod and left. 他敷衍地点了点头就离开了。 | per->彻底，funct->执行（拉丁fungi），perfunctory->只是把程序走完的=敷衍（cf. function功能，defunct停止，malfunction故障） || 文化联想：中文“敷衍地点一下头”最适合帮助记忆 perfunctory，可以说 **a perfunctory nod — “A busy official may give a perfunctory nod without really listening to the question.”**

quiz.question: transitory ___
quiz.explanation: 短暂的; 转瞬即逝的, 短暂的快乐. Fame brings only transitory joy. 名声只带来短暂的快乐。 | transit->经过（拉丁transire），transitory->经过即逝的=短暂的（cf. transition过渡，transit交通，transient短暂的） || 文化联想：“人生如朝露”最适合帮助记忆 transitory，可以说 **transitory joy — “The excitement of winning a minor prize may bring only transitory joy before ordinary life resumes.”**

quiz.question: ____ repository
quiz.explanation: 仓库; 贮藏室, 数据存储库. The data repository stores all records. 数据存储库存储所有记录。 | re->回，posit->放置（拉丁ponere），repository->放东西回去的地方=仓库（cf. deposit存款，compose作曲，expose暴露） || 文化联想：敦煌藏经洞像一座保存知识的宝库，最适合帮助记忆 repository，可以说 **a document repository — “An archive can serve as a document repository that preserves records for future researchers.”**

quiz.question: expository _______
quiz.explanation: 说明的; 解释的, 说明文写作. Students practice expository writing in class. 学生在课堂上练习说明文写作。 | ex->向外，posit->放置，expository->向外放置展开=说明的（cf. expose暴露，exposition博览会，expose暴露） || 文化联想：中国语文课里的说明文最适合帮助记忆 expository，可以说 **expository writing — “Expository writing explains a subject clearly through facts, examples, and logical organization.”**

quiz.question: desultory ____________
quiz.explanation: 散漫的; 不连贯的, 散漫的对话. They engaged in desultory conversation. 他们进行了散漫的对话。 | de->离开，sult->跳（拉丁salire），desultory->从一个跳到另一个=漫无目的（cf. result结果，insult侮辱，exult欢腾，somersault翻筋斗） || 文化联想：中文“东拉西扯、想到哪儿聊到哪儿”最适合帮助记忆 desultory，可以说 **a desultory conversation — “Old friends may drift through a desultory conversation that jumps from family to travel to politics.”**

quiz.question: inventory ____
quiz.explanation: 清单; 存货, 库存清单. Check the inventory list for supplies. 检查物资库存清单。 | invent->找到（拉丁invenire->来到），inventory->找到并记录的=清单（cf. invent发明，invention发明，event事件=出来的事） || 文化联想：中国商店年底盘点库存最适合帮助记忆 inventory，可以说 **an inventory list — “A shopkeeper may check an inventory list while counting every item on the shelves.”**

quiz.question: peremptory _____
quiz.explanation: 专横的; 断然的, 专横的命令. He issued a peremptory order. 他发出了专横的命令。 | per->彻底，empt->取得（拉丁emere->买），peremptory->彻底取消辩解余地的=专横（cf. exempt豁免，preempt抢先，redeem救赎） || 文化联想：古装剧里不容辩驳的严厉命令最适合帮助记忆 peremptory，可以说 **a peremptory order — “A commander may issue a peremptory order that leaves no room for argument.”**

quiz.question: circumlocutory ______
quiz.explanation: 迂回的; 婉转的, 迂回的回答. His circumlocutory answer avoided the question. 他迂回的回答回避了问题。 | circum->绕圈，locut->说（拉丁loqui），circumlocutory->绕圈说话的=迂回的（cf. eloquent雄辩，colloquial口语，soliloquy独白） || 文化联想：中文“绕来绕去就是不正面回答”最适合帮助记忆 circumlocutory，可以说 **a circumlocutory answer — “A spokesperson may give a circumlocutory answer that uses many words while avoiding the central question.”**

quiz.question: statutory ____
quiz.explanation: 法定的; 依法的, 法定职责. It is their statutory duty to report crimes. 报告犯罪是他们的法定职责。 | statut->规定（拉丁statuere），statutory->由法规规定的（cf. statute法规，status地位，institute机构，constitute构成） || 文化联想：中文“白纸黑字写进法律的职责”最适合帮助记忆 statutory，可以说 **a statutory duty — “A public agency may have a statutory duty to publish certain records under the law.”**

quiz.question: harry ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 骚扰; 掠夺, 骚扰敌人. The troops will harry the enemy constantly. 军队将不断骚扰敌人。 | harry->劫掠（古英语hergian->劫掠），harry->骚扰掠夺（cf. harass骚扰，raid突袭，maraud掠夺） || 文化联想：古代轻骑兵不断骚扰敌军的战术最适合帮助记忆 harry，可以说 **harry the enemy — “Mobile troops may harry the enemy with repeated small attacks that prevent rest and regrouping.”**

quiz.question: parry _ ____
quiz.explanation: 挡开; 回避, 挡开一击. The boxer managed to parry a blow. 拳击手设法挡开了一击。 | parry->格挡（法语parer->防护，拉丁parare->准备），parry->格挡攻击（cf. prepare准备，parade阅兵，repair修复） || 文化联想：太极推手顺势化开对方来力最适合帮助记忆 parry，可以说 **parry a blow — “A skilled fighter can parry a blow by redirecting the attack instead of absorbing it directly.”**

quiz.question: _____ quarry
quiz.explanation: 采石场; 猎物, 采石场. Workers extract marble from the stone quarry. 工人从采石场开采大理石。 | quarry->方形石块（拉丁quadraria），quarry->开采方石的地方/猎物（cf. square方形，quarter四分之一，quarrel争吵=争方石？） || 文化联想：北京皇家建筑使用汉白玉所需的采石场最适合帮助记忆 quarry，可以说 **a stone quarry — “Workers at a stone quarry may cut large blocks of marble for construction and sculpture.”**

quiz.question: _____ ferry
quiz.explanation: 渡船, 河渡船. The river ferry crosses every hour. 河渡船每小时过河一次。 | ferry->载运（古英语ferian->运载），ferry->摆渡（cf. ferry渡船，transfer转移，prefer偏好，differ不同） || 文化联想：长江沿岸过去常见的过江渡船最适合帮助记忆 ferry，可以说 **a river ferry — “A river ferry may carry passengers and bicycles between two towns on opposite banks.”**

quiz.question: paltry ___
quiz.explanation: 微不足道的; 可怜的, 微不足道的金额. They offered a paltry sum for the work. 他们为这项工作提供了微不足道的金额。 | paltry->破旧（低地德语palter->破布），paltry->破烂不堪=微不足道（cf. palter搪塞，paltry sum微薄金额） || 文化联想：中文“少得可怜、像打发人一样”最适合帮助记忆 paltry，可以说 **a paltry sum — “Offering only a paltry sum for days of skilled work can feel insulting.”**

quiz.question: _____ infantry
quiz.explanation: 步兵, 轻步兵. The light infantry advanced quickly. 轻步兵快速前进。 | infant->婴儿/无话语权者（拉丁infans->不能说话），infantry->年轻步兵=步兵（cf. infant婴儿，infantile幼稚，infancy婴儿期） || 文化联想：中国军事史里的轻步兵最适合帮助记忆 infantry，可以说 **light infantry — “Light infantry can move quickly on foot and operate with less heavy equipment than armored units.”**

quiz.question: entry ___
quiz.explanation: 入口; 进入, 入场费. Pay the entry fee at the gate. 在门口支付入场费。 | enter->进入（拉丁intrare），entry->进入的行为=入口（cf. enter进入，entrance入口，entrant参赛者，entrepreneur创业者） || 文化联想：中国景区门口买票最适合帮助记忆 entry，可以说 **an entry fee — “Visitors may pay an entry fee before entering a historic garden.”**

quiz.question: ___ gentry
quiz.explanation: 绅士阶层, 绅士阶层. The gentry owned most of the land. 绅士阶层拥有大部分土地。 | gent->出身高贵（拉丁gens->家族），gentry->出身高贵的阶层（cf. gentle温文，gentleman绅士，gender性别，generous慷慨） || 文化联想：明清地方社会中的乡绅阶层最适合帮助记忆 gentry，可以说 **the local gentry — “The local gentry once played an important role in landholding, education, and village affairs.”**

quiz.question: carpentry ______
quiz.explanation: 木工; 木工活, 木工技能. He learned carpentry skills from his father. 他从父亲那里学会了木工技能。 | carpent->运货马车（拉丁carpentum），carpentry->马车制作技能=木工（cf. carpenter木匠，car汽车=轮式交通工具） || 文化联想：中国传统榫卯家具最适合帮助记忆 carpentry，可以说 **carpentry skills — “Building a mortise-and-tenon table requires precise carpentry skills and careful measurement.”**

quiz.question: _________ zealotry
quiz.explanation: 狂热; 盲信, 宗教狂热. Religious zealotry can be dangerous. 宗教狂热可能很危险。 | zeal->热忱（希腊zelos），zealotry->过度热忱=狂热盲信（cf. zealous热心的，jealous嫉妒=过度在意，zeal热情） || 文化联想：zealotry 指过度狂热，可用中国学生学习世界宗教与政治运动时来记忆，可以说 **religious zealotry — “Religious zealotry can become dangerous when absolute certainty turns into hostility toward outsiders.”**

quiz.question: _____ pastry
quiz.explanation: 糕点; 面点, 水果糕点. She baked a delicious fruit pastry. 她烤了美味的水果糕点。 | paste->面团（拉丁pasta），pastry->用面团制作的点心（cf. pasta意面，paste糊，pastel粉彩=面糊颜色，pastor牧师） || 文化联想：苏式酥点层层起酥最适合帮助记忆 pastry，可以说 **a fruit pastry — “A baker may fold butter into dough repeatedly to create the flaky layers of a fruit pastry.”**

quiz.question: _____ ancestry
quiz.explanation: 祖先; 血统, 追溯祖先. DNA tests can trace ancestry. DNA测试可以追溯祖先。 | ances->之前（拉丁ante），try->来的人，ancestry->来自之前的人=祖先（cf. ancestor祖先，antecedent先例，antique古物） || 文化联想：中国族谱一代代追溯先人最适合帮助记忆 ancestry，可以说 **trace ancestry — “A family may use old clan records to trace ancestry across many generations.”**

quiz.question: ____ tapestry
quiz.explanation: 挂毯; 织锦, 丰富的织锦. The wall displayed a rich tapestry. 墙上展示着丰富的织锦。 | tapis->地毯（法语，来自希腊tapets），tapestry->带有图案的厚重织锦（cf. tapis地毯，carpet地毯=来自同根） || 文化联想：苏州缂丝图案繁复如画最适合帮助记忆 tapestry，可以说 **a rich tapestry — “A museum may display a rich tapestry woven with intricate figures, landscapes, and decorative patterns.”**

quiz.question: ______ forestry
quiz.explanation: 林业, 森林林业. Forest forestry manages woodland resources. 森林林业管理林地资源。 | forest->森林（拉丁forestis->户外树林），forestry->森林管理的学问（cf. forest森林，deforest砍伐，afforest造林） || 文化联想：大兴安岭的森林经营和保护最适合帮助记忆 forestry，可以说 **sustainable forestry — “Sustainable forestry aims to manage woodland resources without exhausting them for future generations.”**

quiz.question: ____ sophistry
quiz.explanation: 诡辩; 诡辩术, 纯粹的诡辩. His argument was mere sophistry. 他的论点纯粹是诡辩。 | Sophist->诡辩家（希腊sophos->聪明），sophistry->聪明的外表下的诡辩（cf. sophisticated复杂/世故，philosophy哲学=爱智慧） || 文化联想：中文“强词夺理、听着聪明其实偷换概念”最适合帮助记忆 sophistry，可以说 **mere sophistry — “An argument that hides a weak point behind clever wording may be mere sophistry.”**

quiz.question: ________ artistry
quiz.explanation: 艺术技巧; 艺术性, 艺术技巧. The painting shows remarkable artistic artistry. 这幅画展示了非凡的艺术技巧。 | art->技艺（拉丁ars），artistry->艺术技巧（cf. art艺术，artist艺术家，artisan工匠，artifact人工制品） || 文化联想：苏绣工匠把一根丝线劈成极细丝后绣出层次最适合帮助记忆 artistry，可以说 **remarkable artistry — “The delicate shading in Suzhou embroidery can reveal remarkable artistry and technical control.”**

quiz.question: fury __ _____
quiz.explanation: 狂怒; 狂暴, 风暴的狂怒. The fury of storm destroyed homes. 风暴的狂怒摧毁了房屋。 | furi->狂怒（拉丁furia），fury->极度愤怒（cf. furious狂怒的，infuriate激怒，Furies复仇三女神，furor公众激愤） || 文化联想：中国沿海台风登陆时的猛烈风雨最适合帮助记忆 fury，可以说 **the fury of a storm — “Coastal towns may experience the full fury of a storm when violent wind and rain arrive together.”**

quiz.question: ____ augury
quiz.explanation: 预兆; 占卜, 好兆头. The clear skies were a good augury. 晴朗的天空是好兆头。 | augur->预兆/占卜师（拉丁augur->从鸟兆占卜），augury->鸟兆预测（cf. augur预示，inaugurate就职=举行鸟兆仪式，august威严） || 文化联想：古代占卜看见吉兆最适合帮助记忆 augury，可以说 **a good augury — “Clear skies before a major ceremony may be interpreted as a good augury in a traditional story.”**

quiz.question: ______ perjury
quiz.explanation: 伪证罪, 犯伪证罪. Its illegal to commit perjury in court. 在法庭上犯伪证罪是非法的。 | per->违背，jur->誓言（拉丁jurare），perjury->违背誓言=伪证罪（cf. jury陪审团，injure伤害，abjure放弃=远离誓言） || 文化联想：中文“宣誓之后仍故意作假证”最适合帮助记忆 perjury，可以说 **commit perjury — “A witness who knowingly lies under oath may commit perjury.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ penury
quiz.explanation: 贫困; 赤贫, 生活在贫困中. Many families live in penury. 许多家庭生活在贫困中。 | pen->几乎没有（拉丁paene->几乎），penury->几乎没有钱=赤贫（cf. peninsula半岛=几乎是岛，penultimate倒数第二，penumbra半影） || 文化联想：“家徒四壁”最适合帮助记忆 penury，可以说 **live in penury — “A family with almost no income or savings may live in penury for years.”**

quiz.question: ______ usury
quiz.explanation: 高利贷, 收取高利贷. Its illegal to charge usury rates. 收取高利贷利率是非法的。 | usura->使用/利息（拉丁uti->使用），usury->收取过高利息的行为（cf. use使用，usual通常，usurp篡夺=非法使用，usufruct使用权） || 文化联想：中文“利滚利的高利贷”最适合帮助记忆 usury，可以说 **charge usury — “A predatory lender may charge usury by demanding extremely high interest from desperate borrowers.”**

quiz.question: _______ dowry
quiz.explanation: 嫁妆, 婚礼嫁妆. The bride brought a wedding dowry. 新娘带来了婚礼嫁妆。 | dot->礼物（拉丁dotis->嫁妆），dowry->给予的礼物=嫁妆（cf. endow捐赠，dot捐赠，dote溺爱，anecdote轶事=私下给的） || 文化联想：中国传统婚俗里的嫁妆最适合帮助记忆 dowry，可以说 **a wedding dowry — “In some traditional families, a bride’s parents prepared a wedding dowry of household goods, jewelry, or money.”**

quiz.question: ______ ____ fantasy
quiz.explanation: 幻想; 空想, 逃入幻想. She would escape into fantasy through books. 她会通过书籍逃入幻想。 | phant->显示（希腊phainein），fantasy->心中显示的幻象（cf. phantom幽灵，fantastic奇幻，phenomenon现象，fancy奇思） || 文化联想：《西游记》天马行空的神魔世界最适合帮助记忆 fantasy，可以说 **escape into fantasy — “A reader may escape into fantasy through stories filled with magical journeys, monsters, and immortals.”**

quiz.question: _________ apostasy
quiz.explanation: 背教; 变节, 宗教背教. Religious apostasy was severely punished. 宗教背教受到严厉惩罚。 | apo->离开，stasy->站立（希腊），apostasy->离开原先站立的信仰（cf. ecstasy狂喜=站到外面，apostle使徒，apostate变节者） || 文化联想：apostasy 是“背弃原有宗教信仰”，可用中国学生学习世界宗教史时来记忆，可以说 **religious apostasy — “In religious history, abandoning a faith one once professed may be described as religious apostasy.”**

quiz.question: _________ heresy
quiz.explanation: 异端; 异教, 宗教异端. He was accused of religious heresy. 他被指控犯有宗教异端。 | heresy->选择（希腊hairesis->选择），heresy->自己选择信仰而非遵从=异端（cf. heretic异端者，heir继承人，hereditary遗传） || 文化联想：heresy 是宗教里的“异端”，可用中国学生学习欧洲宗教史时来记忆，可以说 **religious heresy — “A church may label a teaching religious heresy when it directly contradicts doctrines regarded as orthodox.”**

quiz.question: ________ whimsy
quiz.explanation: 奇想; 怪念头, 孩子气的奇想. The story is full of childish whimsy. 故事充满了孩子气的奇想。 | whim->突发奇想（古挪威hvima->眼神游移），whimsy->充满奇异想法的（cf. whim奇想，whimsical奇特的，caprice任性） || 文化联想：孩子把纸箱当宇宙飞船的奇思妙想最适合帮助记忆 whimsy，可以说 **childish whimsy — “Turning a cardboard box into a spaceship is exactly the kind of childish whimsy that fuels imaginative play.”**

quiz.question: rosy _______
quiz.explanation: 玫瑰色的; 乐观的, 乐观的前景. She maintains a rosy outlook on life. 她对生活保持乐观的前景。 | rose->玫瑰（拉丁rosa），rosy->玫瑰色的=乐观的（cf. rose玫瑰，rosary玫瑰念珠，rosacea玫瑰痤疮，rosé玫瑰红酒） || 文化联想：中文“把未来想得一片玫瑰色”最适合帮助记忆 rosy，可以说 **a rosy outlook — “An entrepreneur may maintain a rosy outlook even when the market remains uncertain.”**

quiz.question: brassy ____
quiz.explanation: 黄铜色的; 厚颜的, 刺耳的音调. The trumpet had a brassy tone. 小号有刺耳的音调。 | brass->黄铜（古英语bræs），brassy->像黄铜一样刺耳/厚颜的（cf. brass黄铜，brazen厚颜无耻=黄铜般，bold大胆） || 文化联想：唢呐或铜管乐器高亢刺耳的音色最适合帮助记忆 brassy，可以说 **a brassy tone — “A trumpet played very loudly can produce a brassy tone that cuts through the rest of the band.”**

quiz.question: prissy _______
quiz.explanation: 一本正经的; 拘谨的, 拘谨的举止. Her prissy manners annoyed everyone. 她拘谨的举止惹恼了所有人。 | prissy->过分拘谨（可能来自prim+sissy合并），prissy->过于讲究规矩的（cf. prim一本正经，sissy胆小，fastidious过分讲究） || 文化联想：中文“规矩多得过头、拘谨得让人不自在”最适合帮助记忆 prissy，可以说 **prissy manners — “Someone with prissy manners may fuss over tiny breaches of etiquette at an informal dinner.”**

quiz.question: glossy ________
quiz.explanation: 有光泽的; 精美的, 精美杂志. She read a glossy magazine. 她读了一本精美杂志。 | gloss->光泽（古挪威glossi->发光），glossy->有光泽的=精美的（cf. gloss光泽/注释，polyglot多语言，glossary词汇表） || 文化联想：美容院或候机室里纸张光滑精美的时尚杂志最适合帮助记忆 glossy，可以说 **a glossy magazine — “A glossy magazine often uses polished photographs, smooth paper, and stylish layouts.”**

quiz.question: _____ treaty
quiz.explanation: 条约, 和平条约. Nations signed a peace treaty. 各国签署了和平条约。 | treat->处理（拉丁tractare->拉），treaty->拉拢处理后的协议（cf. treat治疗，retreat撤退，entreat恳求，treatise论文） || 文化联想：中文“签订和平条约”最适合帮助记忆 treaty，可以说 **a peace treaty — “Two countries may sign a peace treaty to formally end a war.”**

quiz.question: _______ entreaty
quiz.explanation: 恳求; 哀求, 恳切的恳求. She made an earnest entreaty for help. 她恳切地恳求帮助。 | en->使，treat->拉/处置，entreaty->拉着手哀求的行为（cf. entreat恳求，treat处理，retreat撤退，treaty条约） || 文化联想：古装剧里跪地恳切求情最适合帮助记忆 entreaty，可以说 **an earnest entreaty — “A desperate petitioner may make an earnest entreaty for mercy before the ruler.”**

quiz.question: crotchety ___ ___
quiz.explanation: 脾气暴躁的; 古怪的, 脾气暴躁的老人. The crotchety old man complained constantly. 脾气暴躁的老人不断抱怨。 | crochet->钩针（法语，小钩），crotchety->像钩子一样挂着怪脾气的=古怪易怒（cf. crotchet四分音符/怪念头，quirky古怪） || 文化联想：中文“脾气古怪、见谁都爱抱怨的老头”最适合帮助记忆 crotchety，可以说 **a crotchety old man — “A crotchety old man may complain about noise, traffic, weather, and nearly everything else.”**

quiz.question: _______ gaiety
quiz.explanation: 欢乐; 快活, 节日欢乐. The holiday gaiety filled the streets. 节日欢乐充满街道。 | gay->快乐（古法语gai->轻松），gaiety->欢乐快活的状态（cf. gay快乐/同性恋，glee欢乐，merriment欢乐） || 文化联想：春节庙会锣鼓喧天、人人喜气洋洋最适合帮助记忆 gaiety，可以说 **holiday gaiety — “Lanterns, music, food stalls, and laughing crowds can fill the streets with holiday gaiety.”**

quiz.question: ________ sobriety
quiz.explanation: 清醒; 节制, 保持清醒. Drivers must maintain sobriety. 司机必须保持清醒。 | sobri->清醒（拉丁sobrius），sobriety->清醒节制的状态（cf. sober清醒，insobriety醉酒，soberingly发人深省地） || 文化联想：酒桌上始终保持清醒克制最适合帮助记忆 sobriety，可以说 **maintain sobriety — “A designated driver must maintain sobriety throughout the evening.”**

quiz.question: _______ propriety
quiz.explanation: 得体; 礼节, 遵守礼节. Always observe propriety in formal settings. 在正式场合总要遵守礼节。 | propri->适当（拉丁proprius->自己的），propriety->符合礼节的行为（cf. proper适当，property财产，appropriate挪用，impropriety失礼） || 文化联想：中文“守礼有分寸、举止得体”最适合帮助记忆 propriety，可以说 **observe propriety — “At a formal memorial ceremony, guests are expected to observe propriety in dress and behavior.”**

quiz.question: persnickety _______
quiz.explanation: 过分讲究的; 挑剔的, 挑剔的细节. She worried about persnickety details. 她担心挑剔的细节。 | persnickety->过分精细（来自pernickety/pernicious精细），persnickety->对细节吹毛求疵的（cf. fastidious讲究，finicky挑剔） || 文化联想：老会计对账连一分钱都要核对最适合帮助记忆 persnickety，可以说 **persnickety details — “A meticulous accountant may spend hours checking persnickety details that everyone else overlooks.”**

quiz.question: __ ___ entirety
quiz.explanation: 全部; 整体, 全部. Read the contract in its entirety. 完整地阅读合同。 | entire->整体（拉丁integer->完整的），entirety->完整的全体（cf. integer整数，integrate整合，disintegrate分解，entire整个） || 文化联想：中文“从头到尾完整看完”最适合帮助记忆 entirety，可以说 **in its entirety — “A buyer should read a contract in its entirety before signing it.”**

quiz.question: crafty ____
quiz.explanation: 狡猾的; 诡计多端的, 狡猾的计划. They devised a crafty plan. 他们设计了一个狡猾的计划。 | craft->技艺/狡猾（古英语cræft->力量/技能），crafty->用技艺算计的=狡猾（cf. craft工艺/诡计，craftsman工匠，witchcraft巫术） || 文化联想：《三国演义》里层层设局的巧计最适合帮助记忆 crafty，可以说 **a crafty plan — “A crafty plan may succeed because it anticipates what the other side expects and exploits that assumption.”**

quiz.question: thrifty _______
quiz.explanation: 节俭的; 节约的, 节俭的购物者. The thrifty shopper looks for bargains. 节俭的购物者寻找便宜货。 | thrift->节约（古挪威þrift->繁荣/积蓄），thrifty->注重积蓄的=节俭（cf. thrive繁荣，spendthrift挥霍者，thrift store旧货店） || 文化联想：老一辈“精打细算、能省则省”的持家方式最适合帮助记忆 thrifty，可以说 **a thrifty shopper — “A thrifty shopper compares prices, waits for discounts, and avoids buying things that are not needed.”**

quiz.question: lofty _____
quiz.explanation: 崇高的; 高尚的, 崇高的理想. He pursued a lofty ideal. 他追求崇高的理想。 | loft->高处（古挪威lopt->空气），lofty->高高在上的=崇高/傲慢（cf. aloft在高处，loft阁楼，loftiness崇高，haughty傲慢） || 文化联想：“为天地立心，为生民立命”这种高远抱负最适合帮助记忆 lofty，可以说 **a lofty ideal — “A young scholar may pursue a lofty ideal of using knowledge to improve society.”**

quiz.question: mighty ______
quiz.explanation: 强大的; 巨大的, 强大的帝国. Rome was a mighty empire. 罗马是一个强大的帝国。 | might->力量（古英语miht），mighty->充满力量的=强大的（cf. might力量，almighty全能，might-have-been本可是，mightily强大地） || 文化联想：汉唐盛世国力强盛的历史形象最适合帮助记忆 mighty，可以说 **a mighty empire — “At its height, a mighty empire may command vast territory, wealth, armies, and political influence.”**

quiz.question: haughty ______
quiz.explanation: 傲慢的; 高傲的, 傲慢的一瞥. She gave him a haughty glance. 她傲慢地瞥了他一眼。 | haut->高（法语，拉丁altus），haughty->高高在上的=傲慢（cf. haute haute cuisine高级法餐，altitude高度，exalt提升） || 文化联想：古装剧里权贵高高在上的眼神最适合帮助记忆 haughty，可以说 **a haughty glance — “A proud noble may give a haughty glance that makes everyone nearby feel looked down upon.”**

quiz.question: ___ laity
quiz.explanation: 俗人; 外行, 俗人. The laity attended the church service. 俗人参加了教堂礼拜。 | laos->人民（希腊），laity->普通人民=俗人/外行（cf. lay平放/世俗的，layman外行，laypeople普通人） || 文化联想：laity 指宗教中的普通信众而非神职人员，可用中国学生学习宗教制度时来记忆，可以说 **the laity — “In many religious traditions, the laity are ordinary believers who are not members of the clergy.”**

quiz.question: ________ probity
quiz.explanation: 正直; 诚实, 个人正直. His personal probity was never questioned. 他的个人正直从未受到质疑。 | prob->证明正直（拉丁probus->好的），probity->经过证明的正直（cf. probe探测，approve批准，reprove责备，disprove反驳） || 文化联想：包公“铁面无私”的形象最适合帮助记忆 probity，可以说 **personal probity — “A judge known for personal probity refuses gifts, favors, and pressure from powerful people.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ acerbity
quiz.explanation: 尖刻; 辛辣, 尖刻的语气. Her voice had a note of acerbity. 她的声音带有尖刻的语气。 | acer->尖锐（拉丁acer->锋利），acerbity->尖锐辛辣的性质（cf. acid酸，acrid辛辣，acrimony尖刻，exacerbate加剧=使更尖锐） || 文化联想：鲁迅杂文里辛辣尖锐的语气最适合帮助记忆 acerbity，可以说 **a note of acerbity — “A satirical essay may contain a note of acerbity when exposing hypocrisy.”**

quiz.question: _____ mendacity
quiz.explanation: 虚假; 谎言, 明显的虚假. His testimony was plain mendacity. 他的证词是明显的虚假。 | mendac->谎言（拉丁mendax->说谎者），mendacity->说谎的行为（cf. mendacious撒谎的，emend修订=改正错误，cf. amend修改） || 文化联想：中文“睁眼说瞎话”最适合帮助记忆 mendacity，可以说 **plain mendacity — “Claiming that obvious evidence does not exist can amount to plain mendacity.”**

quiz.question: __________ tenacity
quiz.explanation: 坚韧; 顽强, 非凡的坚韧. She showed remarkable tenacity. 她表现出非凡的坚韧。 | tenac->持有（拉丁tenax->抓紧），tenacity->紧握不放的特质=坚韧（cf. tenacious顽强，tenant租户，retain保留，tenure任期） || 文化联想：愚公移山最适合帮助记忆 tenacity，可以说 **remarkable tenacity — “The Foolish Old Man shows remarkable tenacity by continuing an enormous task despite repeated obstacles.”**

quiz.question: ______ opacity
quiz.explanation: 不透明性, 屏幕不透明度. Adjust the screen opacity settings. 调整屏幕不透明度设置。 | opac->不透明（拉丁opacus->阴暗），opacity->不透明的性质（cf. opaque不透明，translucent半透明，transparent透明） || 文化联想：中国手机修图时调节图层透明度最适合帮助记忆 opacity，可以说 **screen opacity — “A designer may reduce screen opacity so the background remains partly visible through an overlay.”**

quiz.question: veracity __ ____
quiz.explanation: 真实性; 诚实, 数据的真实性. Question the veracity of data sources. 质疑数据来源的真实性。 | ver->真（拉丁verus），veracity->真实性（cf. verify核实，verdict裁决，veracious真实，aver断言，verisimilar逼真） || 文化联想：中文“数据到底靠不靠谱”最适合帮助记忆 veracity，可以说 **the veracity of data — “A researcher should verify the veracity of data before drawing conclusions from it.”**

quiz.question: _______ voracity
quiz.explanation: 贪食; 贪婪, 贪婪的贪食. quiz.question: ______ infelicity
quiz.explanation: 不幸; 不当, 社交不当. His social infelicity caused embarrassment. 他的社交不当造成了尴尬。 | in->否定，felic->幸福（拉丁felix），infelicity->不幸/不当（cf. felicity幸福，felicitate祝贺，Felix幸运的人名） || 文化联想：中文“社交场合说错话、措辞不得体”最适合帮助记忆 infelicity，可以说 **a social infelicity — “Making a joke about someone’s private hardship at dinner would be a social infelicity.”**

quiz.question: _ multiplicity __
quiz.explanation: 多样性; 多重性, 多样性. quiz.question: ________ complicity
quiz.explanation: 共谋; 串通, 犯罪共谋. He was charged with criminal complicity. 他被指控犯罪共谋。 | com->共同，plic->折叠（拉丁），complicity->共同折叠参与=共谋（cf. complex复杂，complicate使复杂，implicit隐含，explicit明确） || 文化联想：中文“明知违法还一起参与”最适合帮助记忆 complicity，可以说 **criminal complicity — “Someone who knowingly helps conceal an illegal scheme may face accusations of criminal complicity.”**

quiz.question: _________ duplicity
quiz.explanation: 欺骗; 两面派, 政治欺骗. The scandal revealed political duplicity. 丑闻揭露了政治欺骗。 | duplic->双重（拉丁duplex），duplicity->双重性=两面派（cf. duplicate复制，duplex双层，double双重，diploma文凭=双折的） || 文化联想：中文“两面三刀、嘴上一套背后一套”最适合帮助记忆 duplicity，可以说 **political duplicity — “Promising one policy in public while secretly pursuing the opposite can look like political duplicity.”**

quiz.question: ______ authenticity
quiz.explanation: 真实性; 可靠性, 验证真实性. Experts verify authenticity of artwork. 专家验证艺术品的真实性。 | authent->权威/真实（希腊authentikos），authenticity->真实性（cf. authentic真实的，author作者，authority权威） || 文化联想：中国古玩鉴定最适合帮助记忆 authenticity，可以说 **verify authenticity — “Experts may examine materials, inscriptions, and provenance to verify authenticity before buying an antique.”**

quiz.question: _____ inelasticity
quiz.explanation: 无弹性, 价格无弹性. quiz.question: ________ velocity
quiz.explanation: 速度, 终端速度. Objects reach terminal velocity in freefall. 物体在自由落体时达到终端速度。 | veloc->快速（拉丁velox），velocity->快速运动的量=速度（cf. velodromes自行车赛场，accelerate加速，rapid快速） || 文化联想：中国物理课学习跳伞者达到终端速度最适合帮助记忆 velocity，可以说 **terminal velocity — “A falling object approaches terminal velocity when air resistance balances the force pulling it downward.”**

quiz.question: ___ atrocity
quiz.explanation: 暴行; 残暴, 战争暴行. War atrocity shocked the world. 战争暴行震惊了世界。 | atroc->可怕（拉丁atrox->凶残），atrocity->残酷的暴行（cf. atrocious残暴的，atrocity crimes反人类罪） || 文化联想：抗战史中针对平民的严重暴行最适合帮助记忆 atrocity，可以说 **a war atrocity — “A deliberate massacre of civilians during armed conflict can be condemned as a war atrocity.”**

quiz.question: _____ scarcity
quiz.explanation: 稀缺; 不足, 水资源稀缺. Water scarcity affects millions. 水资源稀缺影响数百万人。 | scarce->稀少（古法语escars->吝啬/稀少），scarcity->稀少的状态（cf. scarce稀缺，rare罕见，shortage短缺） || 文化联想：中国北方一些地区长期缺水最适合帮助记忆 scarcity，可以说 **water scarcity — “Water scarcity can force a dry region to conserve reservoirs and limit waste.”**

quiz.question: _ paucity __ ____
quiz.explanation: 缺乏; 少量, 缺乏数据. There is a paucity of data on this topic. 关于这个话题缺乏数据。 | pauci->少（拉丁paucus->少），paucity->极少量（cf. few少，poverty贫困，impoverish使贫困，pauper穷人） || 文化联想：中文“数据少得根本下不了结论”最适合帮助记忆 paucity，可以说 **a paucity of data — “A paucity of data can make a scientific conclusion highly uncertain.”**

quiz.question: _________ frigidity
quiz.explanation: 寒冷; 冷淡, 情感冷淡. quiz.question: timidity _______

quiz.question: ____ fecundity
quiz.explanation: 多产; 肥沃, 土壤肥沃. Soil fecundity determines crop yields. 土壤肥沃决定作物产量。 | fecund->多产（拉丁fecundus），fecundity->多产肥沃的特性（cf. fecund多产，infecund不育，fertile肥沃，fertility生育力） || 文化联想：东北黑土地肥沃、庄稼长势旺盛最适合帮助记忆 fecundity，可以说 **the fecundity of soil — “The fecundity of rich black soil can support abundant crops when water and climate are favorable.”**

quiz.question: ______ commodity
quiz.explanation: 商品, 全球商品. Oil is a valuable global commodity. 石油是有价值的全球商品。 | commod->方便/适宜（拉丁commodus），commodity->方便交换的物品=商品（cf. accommodate适应，commode梳妆台，commodious宽敞） || 文化联想：中国大量进口的大豆、铁矿石和原油都是典型全球商品，最适合帮助记忆 commodity，可以说 **a global commodity — “Crude oil is a global commodity whose price is shaped by supply, demand, and geopolitics.”**

quiz.question: ______ crudity
quiz.explanation: 粗鲁; 粗糙, 社交粗鲁. His social crudity offended guests. 他的社交粗鲁冒犯了客人。 | crud->粗糙（拉丁crudus->生/粗糙），crudity->粗糙未加工的状态（cf. crude原油/粗糙，cruel残忍，rude粗鲁） || 文化联想：中文“举止粗俗、缺少教养”最适合帮助记忆 crudity，可以说 **social crudity — “Shouting insults at a formal dinner may be remembered for its social crudity.”**

quiz.question: _______ spontaneity
quiz.explanation: 自发性; 自然, 真诚的自发性. Her genuine spontaneity was refreshing. 她真诚的自发性令人耳目一新。 | spont->自愿（拉丁sponte->出于意愿），spontaneity->无外力的自发（cf. spontaneous自发的，respond回应，despondent沮丧） || 文化联想：中国朋友聚会时临场自然说笑最适合帮助记忆 spontaneity，可以说 **genuine spontaneity — “An unscripted conversation among close friends often has a genuine spontaneity that staged dialogue lacks.”**

quiz.question: ________ homogeneity
quiz.explanation: 同质性; 均匀性, 文化同质性. Cultural homogeneity characterizes the region. 文化同质性是该地区的特点。 | homo->相同（希腊），genei->种类，homogeneity->相同种类的性质（cf. heterogeneous异质，gender性别，genesis起源） || 文化联想：中文“千城一面、大家越来越像”最适合帮助记忆 homogeneity，可以说 **cultural homogeneity — “When local customs, architecture, and language differences fade, a region may develop greater cultural homogeneity.”**

quiz.question: _____ superficiality
quiz.explanation: 肤浅; 浅薄, 纯粹的肤浅. The analysis showed sheer superficiality. 分析显示了纯粹的肤浅。 | super->表面（拉丁superficies->表面），superficiality->只停在表面的浅薄（cf. surface表面，superficial表面的，edifice建筑） || 文化联想：中文“走马观花、只看表面”最适合帮助记忆 superficiality，可以说 **sheer superficiality — “Judging a complex issue from one headline shows sheer superficiality.”**

quiz.question: ________ partiality
quiz.explanation: 偏心; 偏袒, 司法偏袒. Judicial partiality undermines justice. 司法偏袒破坏了公正。 | part->部分（拉丁pars），partiality->只偏向一部分=偏袒（cf. partial部分的/偏袒，impartial公正，partition分割） || 文化联想：中文“司法偏袒自己人”最适合帮助记忆 partiality，可以说 **judicial partiality — “Judicial partiality undermines trust when a judge favors one side for personal reasons.”**

quiz.question: ____ conviviality
quiz.explanation: 欢乐; 欢宴, 温暖的欢乐. quiz.question: ____ formality
quiz.explanation: 正式; 仪式, 纯粹的形式.
